#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
ArdaBest Async Python MUD Client
================================

A single-file asynchronous Python MUD client for Linux and Windows.

Core architecture requested by the user:
- asyncio.open_connection() for the two-way TCP/Telnet socket.
- async def underwait() continuously reads server traffic.
- Every inbound, outbound, Telnet, trigger, alias, script, and system event is
  written to a valid XML session log.
- Internal pub/sub event bus.
- Aliases are Python functions/regular expressions.
- Variables are normal Python values in client.variables.
- Triggers are Python regular expressions with Python callback functions.
- User automation is loaded from reloadable .py modules that are syntax-checked before activation.
- A NetworkX room graph drives the live graphical automapper.
- A ZeroMQ ROUTER socket exposes room, neighbor, locate, and path queries.
- The default desktop interface shows the MUD terminal and map side by side.

The full ARDABEST room database is embedded in this file in compressed form.
The client requires networkx and pyzmq; prompt_toolkit enables the optional terminal-map mode.
The supplied Linux installer installs them into a private per-user environment without sudo or root.

IMPORTANT: Python scripts placed in profile/scripts execute with your normal
user account permissions. Only install scripts you trust.
"""

# Telnet constants.
IAC = 255
DONT = 254
DO = 253
WONT = 252
WILL = 251
SB = 250
GA = 249
SE = 240
NOP = 241
ECHO = 1
SUPPRESS_GO_AHEAD = 3
TERMINAL_TYPE = 24
NAWS = 31
LINEMODE = 34
CHARSET = 42
MCCP2 = 86
GMCP = 201
BINARY = 0
TTYPE_IS = 0
TTYPE_SEND = 1

DIRECTION_ALIASES = {
    "n": "n", "north": "n",
    "s": "s", "south": "s",
    "e": "e", "east": "e",
    "w": "w", "west": "w",
    "u": "u", "up": "u",
    "d": "d", "down": "d",
}
OPPOSITE_DIRECTION = {"n": "s", "s": "n", "e": "w", "w": "e", "u": "d", "d": "u"}
DIRECTION_DELTA = {
    "n": (0, 1, 0), "s": (0, -1, 0),
    "e": (1, 0, 0), "w": (-1, 0, 0),
    "u": (0, 0, 1), "d": (0, 0, -1),
}
ROOM_LINE_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?P<name>.*?)\s+\(#(?P<vnum>\d+)\)\s+"
    r"\[\s*(?P<terrain>.*?)\s*\]\s+Exits\s+are:\s*"
    r"(?P<exits>.*?)(?:\s+\(\d+\))?\s*$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
ANSI_RE = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]")


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")


def strip_ansi(text: str) -> str:
    return ANSI_RE.sub("", text).replace("\x00", "")


def normalize_direction(value: str) -> str:
    return DIRECTION_ALIASES.get(value.strip().lower(), "")


def profile_default_path() -> Path:
    if os.name == "nt":
        base = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", Path.home()))
        return base / PROFILE_DIR_NAME
    return Path.home() / ".local" / "share" / PROFILE_DIR_NAME


def open_folder(path: Path) -> None:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        if os.name == "nt":
            os.startfile(str(path))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        elif sys.platform == "darwin":
            import subprocess
            subprocess.Popen(["open", str(path)])
        else:
            import subprocess
            subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", str(path)])
    except Exception:
        pass


class XMLTrafficLogger:
    """Append-only XML logger that remains valid after every entry."""

    CLOSING = b"</mudTrafficLog>\n"

    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._sequence = 0
        if not self.path.exists() or self.path.stat().st_size == 0:
            header = (
                '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
                f'<mudTrafficLog application="{xml_escape(APP_NAME)}" version="{APP_VERSION}" '
                f'started="{utc_now()}">\n'
            ).encode("utf-8")
            self.path.write_bytes(header + self.CLOSING)
        else:
            self._repair_if_needed()

    def _repair_if_needed(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            data = self.path.read_bytes()
            if data.rstrip().endswith(b"</mudTrafficLog>"):
                return
            # A prior hard crash may leave an unfinished final entry. Preserve it as a comment.
            safe = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").replace("--", "- -")
            repaired = (
                '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
                f'<mudTrafficLog application="{xml_escape(APP_NAME)}" version="{APP_VERSION}" '
                f'repaired="{utc_now()}">\n'
                '<entry direction="system" kind="repair"><text>Previous log was repaired after an unclean shutdown.</text></entry>\n'
                f'<!-- Previous incomplete bytes:\n{safe}\n-->\n'
                '</mudTrafficLog>\n'
            )
            self.path.write_text(repaired, encoding="utf-8")

    def log(
        self,
        direction: str,
        kind: str,
        *,
        text: str = "",
        raw: bytes | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._sequence += 1
            attrs = {
                "sequence": str(self._sequence),
                "timestamp": utc_now(),
                "direction": direction,
                "kind": kind,
            }
            if raw is not None:
                attrs["byteCount"] = str(len(raw))
            if metadata:
                for key, value in metadata.items():
                    if value is not None:
                        attrs[str(key)] = str(value)
            entry = ET.Element("entry", attrs)
            if text:
                ET.SubElement(entry, "text").text = text
            if raw is not None:
                ET.SubElement(entry, "raw encoding", {}) if False else None
                raw_node = ET.SubElement(entry, "raw")
                raw_node.set("encoding", "base64")
                raw_node.text = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")
            payload = ET.tostring(entry, encoding="utf-8", short_empty_elements=True) + b"\n"
            with self.path.open("r+b") as handle:
                handle.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
                size = handle.tell()
                seek_back = len(self.CLOSING)
                if size < seek_back:
                    raise OSError(f"XML log is unexpectedly short: {self.path}")
                handle.seek(-seek_back, os.SEEK_END)
                handle.write(payload)
                handle.write(self.CLOSING)
                handle.truncate()
                handle.flush()
                with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())


EventCallback = Callable[..., Any]


class EventBus:
    """Small in-process pub/sub bus supporting sync and async subscribers."""

    def __init__(self, logger: XMLTrafficLogger | None = None) -> None:
        self._subscribers: dict[str, list[tuple[str, EventCallback]]] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self.logger = logger

    def subscribe(self, topic: str, callback: EventCallback) -> str:
        token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        with self._lock:
            self._subscribers.setdefault(topic, []).append((token, callback))
        return token

    def unsubscribe(self, token: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            for topic in list(self._subscribers):
                self._subscribers[topic] = [pair for pair in self._subscribers[topic] if pair[0] != token]
                if not self._subscribers[topic]:
                    del self._subscribers[topic]

    async def publish(self, topic: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            callbacks = list(self._subscribers.get(topic, [])) + list(self._subscribers.get("*", []))
        if self.logger and topic not in {"network.raw.in", "network.raw.out"}:
            compact = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool, type(None)))}
            self.logger.log("event", topic, text=json.dumps(compact, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
        for _, callback in callbacks:
            try:
                result = callback(topic=topic, **payload)
                if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                    await result
            except Exception as exc:
                if self.logger:
                    self.logger.log(
                        "system", "subscriber-error", text=traceback.format_exc(),
                        metadata={"topic": topic, "callback": repr(callback), "error": repr(exc)},
                    )


@dataclass(slots=True)
class AliasContext:
    client: "MudClientCore"
    original: str
    match: re.Match[str]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class TriggerContext:
    client: "MudClientCore"
    line: str
    match: re.Match[str]
    raw_block: str = ""


AliasCallback = Callable[[AliasContext], Any]
TriggerCallback = Callable[[TriggerContext], Any]


@dataclass(order=True)
class AliasRule:
    sort_index: tuple[int, int] = field(init=False, repr=False)
    priority: int
    order: int
    name: str = field(compare=False)
    pattern_text: str = field(compare=False)
    pattern: Pattern[str] = field(compare=False)
    callback: AliasCallback = field(compare=False)
    enabled: bool = field(default=True, compare=False)
    stop: bool = field(default=True, compare=False)
    owner: str = field(default="user", compare=False)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.sort_index = (-self.priority, self.order)


@dataclass(order=True)
class TriggerRule:
    sort_index: tuple[int, int] = field(init=False, repr=False)
    priority: int
    order: int
    name: str = field(compare=False)
    pattern_text: str = field(compare=False)
    pattern: Pattern[str] = field(compare=False)
    callback: TriggerCallback = field(compare=False)
    enabled: bool = field(default=True, compare=False)
    stop: bool = field(default=False, compare=False)
    one_shot: bool = field(default=False, compare=False)
    owner: str = field(default="user", compare=False)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.sort_index = (-self.priority, self.order)


class AutomationRegistry:
    def __init__(self, client: "MudClientCore") -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.aliases: list[AliasRule] = []
        self.triggers: list[TriggerRule] = []
        self._order = 0
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def alias(
        self,
        pattern: str,
        callback: AliasCallback | None = None,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        flags: int = re.IGNORECASE,
        priority: int = 0,
        enabled: bool = True,
        stop: bool = True,
        owner: str = "user",
    ):
        def register(function: AliasCallback) -> AliasCallback:
            with self._lock:
                self._order += 1
                rule = AliasRule(
                    priority=priority, order=self._order, name=name or function.__name__,
                    pattern_text=pattern, pattern=re.compile(pattern, flags), callback=function,
                    enabled=enabled, stop=stop, owner=owner,
                )
                self.aliases.append(rule)
                self.aliases.sort()
            return function
        return register(callback) if callback else register

    def trigger(
        self,
        pattern: str,
        callback: TriggerCallback | None = None,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        flags: int = re.IGNORECASE,
        priority: int = 0,
        enabled: bool = True,
        stop: bool = False,
        one_shot: bool = False,
        owner: str = "user",
    ):
        def register(function: TriggerCallback) -> TriggerCallback:
            with self._lock:
                self._order += 1
                rule = TriggerRule(
                    priority=priority, order=self._order, name=name or function.__name__,
                    pattern_text=pattern, pattern=re.compile(pattern, flags), callback=function,
                    enabled=enabled, stop=stop, one_shot=one_shot, owner=owner,
                )
                self.triggers.append(rule)
                self.triggers.sort()
            return function
        return register(callback) if callback else register

    def command_alias(self, pattern: str, command_template: str, **kwargs: Any) -> AliasCallback:
        async def callback(ctx: AliasContext) -> None:
            groups = ctx.match.groupdict()
            groups.update({str(i): value for i, value in enumerate(ctx.match.groups(), start=1)})
            try:
                command = command_template.format(*ctx.match.groups(), **ctx.match.groupdict())
            except Exception:
                command = command_template
            await ctx.client.send(command)
        return self.alias(pattern, callback, **kwargs)

    def command_trigger(self, pattern: str, command_template: str, **kwargs: Any) -> TriggerCallback:
        async def callback(ctx: TriggerContext) -> None:
            try:
                command = command_template.format(*ctx.match.groups(), **ctx.match.groupdict())
            except Exception:
                command = command_template
            await ctx.client.send(command)
        return self.trigger(pattern, callback, **kwargs)

    def remove_owner(self, owner: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self.aliases = [rule for rule in self.aliases if rule.owner != owner]
            self.triggers = [rule for rule in self.triggers if rule.owner != owner]

    async def process_alias(self, text: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            rules = list(self.aliases)
        matched = False
        for rule in rules:
            if not rule.enabled:
                continue
            match = rule.pattern.fullmatch(text)
            if not match:
                continue
            matched = True
            self.client.logger.log("automation", "alias", text=text, metadata={"name": rule.name, "pattern": rule.pattern_text})
            await self.client.bus.publish("alias.matched", name=rule.name, text=text)
            result = rule.callback(AliasContext(self.client, text, match))
            if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                await result
            if rule.stop:
                break
        return matched

    async def process_line(self, line: str, raw_block: str = "") -> None:
        with self._lock:
            rules = list(self.triggers)
        remove: list[TriggerRule] = []
        for rule in rules:
            if not rule.enabled:
                continue
            match = rule.pattern.search(line)
            if not match:
                continue
            self.client.logger.log("automation", "trigger", text=line, metadata={"name": rule.name, "pattern": rule.pattern_text})
            await self.client.bus.publish("trigger.matched", name=rule.name, line=line)
            result = rule.callback(TriggerContext(self.client, line, match, raw_block))
            if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                await result
            if rule.one_shot:
                remove.append(rule)
            if rule.stop:
                break
        if remove:
            with self._lock:
                self.triggers = [rule for rule in self.triggers if rule not in remove]


class VariableStore(dict[str, Any]):
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = path
        super().__init__()
        self.load()

    def load(self) -> None:
        self.clear()
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                self.update(data)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def save(self) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = self.path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(self, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
        temp.replace(self.path)

    def set(self, key: str, value: Any, save: bool = True) -> None:
        self[key] = value
        if save:
            self.save()


@dataclass(slots=True)
class TelnetEvent:
    command: int
    option: int | None = None
    payload: bytes = b""


class TelnetCodec:
    """Incremental Telnet parser with basic negotiation and GMCP support."""

    def __init__(self, terminal_name: str = "ARDABEST-PYTHON") -> None:
        self.terminal_name = terminal_name.encode("ascii", errors="replace")
        self.state = "data"
        self.negotiation_command = 0
        self.sub_option = 0
        self.sub_buffer = bytearray()
        self.gmcp_enabled = False
        self.remote_echo = False

    @staticmethod
    def _cmd(command: int, option: int) -> bytes:
        return bytes((IAC, command, option))

    @staticmethod
    def _sub(option: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
        payload = payload.replace(bytes((IAC,)), bytes((IAC, IAC)))
        return bytes((IAC, SB, option)) + payload + bytes((IAC, SE))

    def initial_negotiation(self, width: int = 100, height: int = 40) -> list[bytes]:
        width = max(1, min(65535, width))
        height = max(1, min(65535, height))
        return [
            self._cmd(WILL, TERMINAL_TYPE),
            self._cmd(WILL, NAWS),
            self._cmd(WILL, SUPPRESS_GO_AHEAD),
            self._sub(NAWS, width.to_bytes(2, "big") + height.to_bytes(2, "big")),
        ]

    def feed(self, data: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, list[bytes], list[TelnetEvent]]:
        output = bytearray()
        replies: list[bytes] = []
        events: list[TelnetEvent] = []
        for byte in data:
            if self.state == "data":
                if byte == IAC:
                    self.state = "iac"
                else:
                    output.append(byte)
            elif self.state == "iac":
                if byte == IAC:
                    output.append(IAC)
                    self.state = "data"
                elif byte in (WILL, WONT, DO, DONT):
                    self.negotiation_command = byte
                    self.state = "negotiation"
                elif byte == SB:
                    self.state = "sub-option"
                else:
                    events.append(TelnetEvent(byte))
                    self.state = "data"
            elif self.state == "negotiation":
                option = byte
                command = self.negotiation_command
                events.append(TelnetEvent(command, option))
                if command == WILL:
                    if option in (ECHO, SUPPRESS_GO_AHEAD, BINARY, GMCP):
                        replies.append(self._cmd(DO, option))
                        if option == ECHO:
                            self.remote_echo = True
                        if option == GMCP:
                            self.gmcp_enabled = True
                            replies.append(self._sub(GMCP, b'Core.Hello {"client":"ArdaBest Python","version":"1.0"}'))
                    elif option == MCCP2:
                        # Compression is deliberately rejected until a full MCCP stream is active.
                        replies.append(self._cmd(DONT, option))
                    else:
                        replies.append(self._cmd(DONT, option))
                elif command == WONT:
                    if option == ECHO:
                        self.remote_echo = False
                    if option == GMCP:
                        self.gmcp_enabled = False
                elif command == DO:
                    if option in (TERMINAL_TYPE, NAWS, SUPPRESS_GO_AHEAD, BINARY):
                        replies.append(self._cmd(WILL, option))
                    else:
                        replies.append(self._cmd(WONT, option))
                elif command == DONT:
                    replies.append(self._cmd(WONT, option))
                self.state = "data"
            elif self.state == "sub-option":
                self.sub_option = byte
                self.sub_buffer.clear()
                self.state = "sub-data"
            elif self.state == "sub-data":
                if byte == IAC:
                    self.state = "sub-iac"
                else:
                    self.sub_buffer.append(byte)
            elif self.state == "sub-iac":
                if byte == IAC:
                    self.sub_buffer.append(IAC)
                    self.state = "sub-data"
                elif byte == SE:
                    payload = bytes(self.sub_buffer)
                    events.append(TelnetEvent(SB, self.sub_option, payload))
                    if self.sub_option == TERMINAL_TYPE and payload[:1] == bytes((TTYPE_SEND,)):
                        replies.append(self._sub(TERMINAL_TYPE, bytes((TTYPE_IS,)) + self.terminal_name))
                    self.state = "data"
                else:
                    self.state = "data"
        return bytes(output), replies, events


class AsyncTelnetConnection:
    """Two-way asyncio stream connection. underwait() is the receive loop."""

    def __init__(self, client: "MudClientCore") -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.reader: asyncio.StreamReader | None = None
        self.writer: asyncio.StreamWriter | None = None
        self.reader_task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self.codec = TelnetCodec()
        self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")
        self.connected = False
        self.host = ""
        self.port = 0
        self._send_lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def connect(self, host: str, port: int) -> None:
        await self.disconnect("reconnect")
        self.host, self.port = host, port
        await self.client.bus.publish("connection.connecting", host=host, port=port)
        self.client.logger.log("system", "connecting", text=f"{host}:{port}")
        try:
            self.reader, self.writer = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_connection(host, port), timeout=20.0)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.client.logger.log("system", "connect-error", text=traceback.format_exc())
            await self.client.bus.publish("connection.error", error=str(exc), host=host, port=port)
            raise
        self.connected = True
        peer = self.writer.get_extra_info("peername") if self.writer else None
        await self.client.bus.publish("connection.connected", host=host, port=port, peer=str(peer))
        for packet in self.codec.initial_negotiation():
            await self.send_raw(packet, kind="telnet-negotiation")
        self.reader_task = asyncio.create_task(self.underwait(), name="ardabest-underwait")

    async def underwait(self) -> None:
        """Wait under the connection and process incoming Telnet traffic forever."""
        assert self.reader is not None
        try:
            while self.connected:
                data = await self.reader.read(65536)
                if not data:
                    break
                self.client.logger.log("inbound", "socket-bytes", raw=data)
                await self.client.bus.publish("network.raw.in", raw=data)
                clean, replies, telnet_events = self.codec.feed(data)
                for event in telnet_events:
                    await self._handle_telnet_event(event)
                for reply in replies:
                    await self.send_raw(reply, kind="telnet-reply")
                if clean:
                    text = self.decoder.decode(clean)
                    self.client.logger.log("inbound", "text", text=text, raw=clean)
                    await self.client.receive_text(text)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            self.client.logger.log("system", "reader-error", text=traceback.format_exc())
            await self.client.bus.publish("connection.error", error=str(exc), host=self.host, port=self.port)
        finally:
            was_connected = self.connected
            self.connected = False
            if self.writer:
                self.writer.close()
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    await self.writer.wait_closed()
            self.reader = None
            self.writer = None
            if was_connected:
                await self.client.bus.publish("connection.disconnected", reason="server closed connection")

    async def _handle_telnet_event(self, event: TelnetEvent) -> None:
        name = {
            WILL: "WILL", WONT: "WONT", DO: "DO", DONT: "DONT", SB: "SB",
            GA: "GA", NOP: "NOP",
        }.get(event.command, str(event.command))
        metadata = {"command": name, "option": event.option}
        self.client.logger.log("telnet", "negotiation", raw=event.payload or None, metadata=metadata)
        await self.client.bus.publish("telnet.event", event=event, command=name, option=event.option)
        if event.command == SB and event.option == GMCP:
            text = event.payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            package, _, body = text.partition(" ")
            parsed: Any = body
            if body:
                with contextlib.suppress(json.JSONDecodeError):
                    parsed = json.loads(body)
            self.client.logger.log("inbound", "gmcp", text=text, raw=event.payload, metadata={"package": package})
            await self.client.bus.publish("gmcp", package=package, data=parsed, raw=text)

    async def send_raw(self, data: bytes, kind: str = "socket-bytes") -> None:
        if not self.connected or not self.writer:
            raise ConnectionError("Not connected")
        async with self._send_lock:
            self.writer.write(data)
            await self.writer.drain()
        self.client.logger.log("outbound", kind, raw=data)
        await self.client.bus.publish("network.raw.out", raw=data)

    async def send_line(self, text: str) -> None:
        payload = text.rstrip("\r\n").encode("utf-8", errors="replace") + b"\r\n"
        self.client.logger.log("outbound", "command", text=text, raw=payload)
        await self.send_raw(payload, kind="command-bytes")

    async def disconnect(self, reason: str = "user") -> None:
        self.connected = False
        task = self.reader_task
        self.reader_task = None
        if task and task is not asyncio.current_task():
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
                await task
        if self.writer:
            self.writer.close()
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                await self.writer.wait_closed()
        self.reader = None
        self.writer = None
        await self.client.bus.publish("connection.disconnected", reason=reason)


@dataclass
class Room:
    id: int
    area: int
    x: int
    y: int
    z: int
    name: str
    terrain: str
    exits: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    observed_exits: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    vnum: int | None = None
    color: str = ""
    emoji: str = ""
    note: str = ""
    deleted: bool = False

    def display_name(self) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"\s*\(#\d+\)\s*(?:\[[^]]*\])?\s*$", "", self.name).strip() or self.name


class MapperModel:
    def __init__(self, profile_dir: Path, logger: XMLTrafficLogger) -> None:
        self.profile_dir = profile_dir
        self.logger = logger
        self.rooms: dict[int, Room] = {}
        self.vnum_to_id: dict[int, int] = {}
        self.areas: dict[int, str] = {}
        self.current_room_id: int | None = None
        self.previous_room_id: int | None = None
        self.pending_direction = ""
        self.mapping_enabled = False
        self._next_custom_id = -1
        self.modified_ids: set[int] = set()
        self.custom_path = profile_dir / "custom_map.json"
        self.load_embedded_map()
        self.load_customizations()

    def load_embedded_map(self) -> None:
        try:
            compressed = base64.b85decode("".join(MAP_DATA_B85.split()).encode("ascii"))
            document = json.loads(zlib.decompress(compressed).decode("utf-8"))
            for key, value in document.get("areaNames", {}).items():
                self.areas[int(key)] = str(value)
            for item in document.get("rooms", []):
                room_id = int(item["id"])
                room_name = str(item.get("name", ""))
                vnum_match = re.search(r"\(#(\d+)\)", room_name)
                vnum = int(vnum_match.group(1)) if vnum_match else None
                room = Room(
                    id=room_id,
                    area=int(item.get("area", -1)),
                    x=int(item.get("x", 0)), y=int(item.get("y", 0)), z=int(item.get("z", 0)),
                    name=room_name, terrain=str(item.get("terrain", "")),
                    exits={normalize_direction(k): int(v) for k, v in dict(item.get("exits", {})).items() if normalize_direction(k)},
                    vnum=vnum,
                )
                self.rooms[room_id] = room
                if vnum is not None:
                    self.vnum_to_id[vnum] = room_id
            self.logger.log("system", "map-loaded", text=f"Loaded {len(self.rooms)} embedded rooms")
        except Exception:
            self.logger.log("system", "map-load-error", text=traceback.format_exc())

    def load_customizations(self) -> None:
        if not self.custom_path.exists():
            return
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.custom_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.mapping_enabled = bool(data.get("mappingEnabled", False))
            saved_current = data.get("currentRoomId")
            if isinstance(saved_current, int):
                self.current_room_id = saved_current
            for item in data.get("rooms", []):
                room_id = int(item["id"])
                if room_id in self.rooms:
                    room = self.rooms[room_id]
                else:
                    room = Room(
                        id=room_id, area=int(item.get("area", -1)), x=int(item.get("x", 0)),
                        y=int(item.get("y", 0)), z=int(item.get("z", 0)),
                        name=str(item.get("name", f"Custom room {room_id}")),
                        terrain=str(item.get("terrain", "Unknown")),
                    )
                    self.rooms[room_id] = room
                for key in ("area", "x", "y", "z", "name", "terrain", "color", "emoji", "note", "deleted"):
                    if key in item:
                        setattr(room, key, item[key])
                if "vnum" in item and item["vnum"] is not None:
                    room.vnum = int(item["vnum"])
                    self.vnum_to_id[room.vnum] = room.id
                if "exits" in item:
                    room.exits = {normalize_direction(k): int(v) for k, v in item["exits"].items() if normalize_direction(k)}
                self._next_custom_id = min(self._next_custom_id, room.id - 1)
        except Exception:
            self.logger.log("system", "custom-map-load-error", text=traceback.format_exc())

    def save(self) -> None:
        changed_rooms = []
        for room in self.rooms.values():
            if room.id < 0 or room.id in self.modified_ids or room.color or room.emoji or room.note or room.deleted:
                changed_rooms.append(dataclasses.asdict(room))
        data = {"mappingEnabled": self.mapping_enabled, "currentRoomId": self.current_room_id, "rooms": changed_rooms}
        self.custom_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = self.custom_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        temp.replace(self.custom_path)
        self.logger.log("system", "map-saved", text=str(self.custom_path), metadata={"rooms": len(changed_rooms)})

    def room_for_vnum(self, vnum: int) -> Room | None:
        room_id = self.vnum_to_id.get(vnum)
        return self.rooms.get(room_id) if room_id is not None else None

    def set_current(self, room_id: int | None) -> None:
        if room_id is None or room_id not in self.rooms:
            return
        self.previous_room_id = self.current_room_id
        self.current_room_id = room_id

    def remember_move(self, command: str) -> None:
        direction = normalize_direction(command.split(maxsplit=1)[0] if command.strip() else "")
        if self.mapping_enabled and direction:
            self.pending_direction = direction

    def detect_room_line(self, line: str) -> Room | None:
        match = ROOM_LINE_RE.match(strip_ansi(line))
        if not match:
            return None
        vnum = int(match.group("vnum"))
        name = match.group("name").strip()
        terrain = match.group("terrain").strip()
        exit_tokens = [normalize_direction(token.strip("(),")) for token in match.group("exits").split()]
        exit_tokens = [token for token in exit_tokens if token]
        room = self.room_for_vnum(vnum)
        if room is None and self.mapping_enabled:
            room = self._create_room(vnum, name, terrain)
        if room is None:
            return None
        room.vnum = vnum
        room.name = f"{name} (#{vnum}) [{terrain}]"
        room.terrain = terrain
        room.observed_exits = list(dict.fromkeys(exit_tokens))
        self.vnum_to_id[vnum] = room.id
        old_current = self.current_room_id
        self.set_current(room.id)
        if self.mapping_enabled and self.pending_direction and old_current is not None and old_current != room.id:
            self.link_rooms(old_current, self.pending_direction, room.id)
        self.pending_direction = ""
        # Preserve existing destination ids, but expose all printed exits as unknown placeholders only in UI.
        room.note = room.note
        return room

    def _create_room(self, vnum: int, name: str, terrain: str) -> Room:
        base = self.rooms.get(self.current_room_id) if self.current_room_id is not None else None
        direction = self.pending_direction
        dx, dy, dz = DIRECTION_DELTA.get(direction, (1, 0, 0))
        room = Room(
            id=self._next_custom_id,
            area=base.area if base else -1,
            x=(base.x + dx) if base else 0,
            y=(base.y + dy) if base else 0,
            z=(base.z + dz) if base else 0,
            name=f"{name} (#{vnum}) [{terrain}]", terrain=terrain, vnum=vnum,
        )
        self._next_custom_id -= 1
        self.rooms[room.id] = room
        self.vnum_to_id[vnum] = room.id
        return room

    def link_rooms(self, from_id: int, direction: str, to_id: int) -> None:
        direction = normalize_direction(direction)
        if not direction or from_id not in self.rooms or to_id not in self.rooms:
            return
        self.rooms[from_id].exits[direction] = to_id
        self.rooms[to_id].exits[OPPOSITE_DIRECTION[direction]] = from_id
        self.modified_ids.update((from_id, to_id))
        self.logger.log("mapper", "link", text=f"{from_id} {direction} {to_id}")

    def search(self, needle: str, limit: int = 100) -> list[Room]:
        needle = needle.strip().lower()
        if not needle:
            return []
        results = []
        for room in self.rooms.values():
            if room.deleted:
                continue
            area_name = self.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area)).lower()
            haystack = f"{room.id} {room.vnum or ''} {room.name} {room.terrain} {area_name} {room.note}".lower()
            if needle in haystack:
                results.append(room)
                if len(results) >= limit:
                    break
        return results

    def visible_rooms(self, area: int, z: int) -> list[Room]:
        return [room for room in self.rooms.values() if room.area == area and room.z == z and not room.deleted]

    @staticmethod
    def emoji_for(room: Room) -> str:
        if room.emoji:
            return room.emoji
        text = f"{room.terrain} {room.name}".lower()
        rules = [
            (("stable", "stables"), "🐴"), (("butcher",), "🔪"), (("tailor",), "🧵"),
            (("blacksmith", "forge"), "⚒"), (("armour", "armor"), "🛡"),
            (("shop", "store", "market"), "🛒"), (("inn", "tavern", "alehouse"), "🍺"),
            (("gate",), "🏰"), (("trophy", "victory"), "🏆"),
            (("skeleton", "undead", "crypt"), "💀"), (("bandit", "rogue", "thief"), "🗡"),
            (("water", "lake", "river"), "🌊"), (("forest", "wood"), "🌲"),
            (("mountain", "hill"), "⛰"), (("cave", "tunnel", "mine"), "🕳"),
            (("orc",), "👹"), (("wolf",), "🐺"), (("field", "grass"), "🌿"),
        ]
        for needles, emoji in rules:
            if any(needle in text for needle in needles):
                return emoji
        return "·"


class ScriptManager:
    def __init__(self, client: "MudClientCore", scripts_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.scripts_dir = scripts_dir
        self.modules: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.scripts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._write_example_if_missing()

    def _write_example_if_missing(self) -> None:
        path = self.scripts_dir / "example_automation.py"
        if path.exists():
            return
        example = r'''"""Example pure-Python aliases, triggers, variables, and pub/sub."""

def setup(client):
    # Aliases use Python regular expressions and Python functions.
    @client.alias(r"^qq$")
    async def quick_quit(ctx):
        await client.send("quit")

    @client.alias(r"^k\s+(.+)$")
    async def kill_shortcut(ctx):
        await client.send(f"kill {ctx.match.group(1)}")

    # Variables are ordinary Python values in client.variables.
    client.variables.setdefault("example_counter", 0)

    # Triggers are Python regular expressions.
    @client.trigger(r"You receive .*?(\d+) points", name="Count XP")
    async def count_xp(ctx):
        amount = int(ctx.match.group(1))
        client.variables["example_counter"] += amount
        client.variables.save()

    # Pub/sub: listen to any event produced by the client.
    def connected(topic, host, port, **_):
        client.system(f"Python script saw connection to {host}:{port}")
    client.subscribe("connection.connected", connected)
'''
        path.write_text(example, encoding="utf-8")

    async def reload(self) -> bool:
        """Syntax-check every module first, then activate the complete set.

        A syntax error leaves the currently loaded automation untouched. This avoids
        destroying a working trigger/alias set because one edited file is incomplete.
        """
        candidates: list[tuple[Path, str, Any]] = []
        syntax_errors: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
        for path in sorted(self.scripts_dir.glob("*.py")):
            if path.name.startswith("_"):
                continue
            owner = f"script:{path.resolve()}"
            try:
                source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                code = compile(source, str(path), "exec", dont_inherit=True, optimize=0)
                candidates.append((path, owner, code))
                self.client.logger.log("script", "syntax-ok", text=str(path))
            except Exception:
                error = traceback.format_exc()
                syntax_errors.append((path, error))
                self.client.logger.log("script", "syntax-error", text=error, metadata={"path": str(path)})
                await self.client.bus.publish("script.error", path=str(path), error=error, phase="syntax-check")

        if syntax_errors:
            await self.client.bus.publish(
                "system.message",
                text=(f"Reload cancelled: {len(syntax_errors)} Python module(s) failed syntax checking. "
                      "The previously loaded automation is still active."),
            )
            return False

        # Build module objects and execute top-level code before touching active rules.
        staged: list[tuple[Path, str, Any]] = []
        for path, owner, code in candidates:
            try:
                module_name = f"ardabest_user_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
                module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(
                    importlib.util.spec_from_loader(module_name, loader=None, origin=str(path))
                )
                module.__file__ = str(path)
                module.__package__ = ""
                exec(code, module.__dict__)
                staged.append((path, owner, module))
            except Exception:
                error = traceback.format_exc()
                self.client.logger.log("script", "stage-error", text=error, metadata={"path": str(path)})
                await self.client.bus.publish("script.error", path=str(path), error=error, phase="stage")
                await self.client.bus.publish(
                    "system.message",
                    text=f"Reload cancelled while staging {path.name}. Previous automation remains active.",
                )
                return False

        for owner, module in list(self.modules.items()):
            teardown = getattr(module, "teardown", None)
            if teardown:
                try:
                    result = teardown(self.client)
                    if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                        await result
                except Exception:
                    self.client.logger.log("script", "teardown-error", text=traceback.format_exc(), metadata={"owner": owner})
            self.client.automation.remove_owner(owner)
            self.client.unsubscribe_owner(owner)
        self.modules.clear()

        loaded = 0
        for path, owner, module in staged:
            try:
                self.client._active_script_owner = owner
                setup = getattr(module, "setup", None)
                if setup:
                    result = setup(self.client)
                    if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                        await result
                self.modules[owner] = module
                loaded += 1
                self.client.logger.log("script", "loaded", text=str(path))
                await self.client.bus.publish("script.loaded", path=str(path), syntax_checked=True)
            except Exception:
                error = traceback.format_exc()
                self.client.logger.log("script", "load-error", text=error, metadata={"path": str(path)})
                await self.client.bus.publish("script.error", path=str(path), error=error, phase="setup")
            finally:
                self.client._active_script_owner = "user"

        await self.client.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Reloaded {loaded} syntax-checked Python module(s).")
        return True


class Profile:
    def __init__(self, profile_dir: Path) -> None:
        self.dir = profile_dir
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.path = self.dir / "profile.json"
        self.data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "host": DEFAULT_HOST,
            "port": DEFAULT_PORT,
            "fontSize": 12,
            "roomShape": "square",
            "showNames": False,
            "showGrid": True,
            "mapZoom": 1.0,
            "terminalMapMode": "medium",
            "zmqEnabled": True,
            "zmqEndpoint": "tcp://127.0.0.1:5555",
        }
        self.load()

    def load(self) -> None:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        try:
            loaded = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(loaded, dict):
                self.data.update(loaded)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def save(self) -> None:
        temp = self.path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(self.data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        temp.replace(self.path)


class NetworkGraphAdapter:
    """NetworkX view of MapperModel, kept current as rooms are observed or linked."""

    def __init__(self, mapper: MapperModel, logger: XMLTrafficLogger) -> None:
        if nx is None:
            raise RuntimeError("networkx is required. Run the supplied Linux no-root installer.")
        self.mapper = mapper
        self.logger = logger
        self.graph = nx.DiGraph()
        self.rebuild()

    def rebuild(self) -> None:
        self.graph.clear()
        for room in self.mapper.rooms.values():
            if not room.deleted:
                self._put_node(room)
        for room in self.mapper.rooms.values():
            if room.deleted or room.id not in self.graph:
                continue
            for direction, target_id in room.exits.items():
                if target_id in self.graph:
                    self.graph.add_edge(room.id, target_id, direction=normalize_direction(direction))
        self.logger.log(
            "mapper", "networkx-rebuilt",
            text=f"NetworkX graph contains {self.graph.number_of_nodes()} rooms and {self.graph.number_of_edges()} directed exits",
        )

    def _put_node(self, room: Room) -> None:
        self.graph.add_node(
            room.id,
            id=room.id,
            vnum=room.vnum,
            name=room.display_name(),
            full_name=room.name,
            terrain=room.terrain,
            area=room.area,
            area_name=self.mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area)),
            x=room.x, y=room.y, z=room.z,
            note=room.note,
            color=room.color,
            deleted=room.deleted,
        )

    def sync_room(self, room: Room | None) -> None:
        if room is None or room.deleted:
            return
        self._put_node(room)
        # Replace outgoing edges so NetworkX exactly follows the mapper's exits.
        if room.id in self.graph:
            self.graph.remove_edges_from(list(self.graph.out_edges(room.id)))
        for direction, target_id in room.exits.items():
            target = self.mapper.rooms.get(target_id)
            if target and not target.deleted:
                self._put_node(target)
                self.graph.add_edge(room.id, target_id, direction=normalize_direction(direction))
        # A new link may also have changed the previous room.
        previous = self.mapper.rooms.get(self.mapper.previous_room_id) if self.mapper.previous_room_id is not None else None
        if previous and previous.id != room.id:
            self._put_node(previous)
            self.graph.remove_edges_from(list(self.graph.out_edges(previous.id)))
            for direction, target_id in previous.exits.items():
                target = self.mapper.rooms.get(target_id)
                if target and not target.deleted:
                    self._put_node(target)
                    self.graph.add_edge(previous.id, target_id, direction=normalize_direction(direction))

    def resolve(self, room_number: Any) -> int | None:
        try:
            number = int(str(room_number).strip())
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None
        room = self.mapper.room_for_vnum(number)
        if room and room.id in self.graph:
            return room.id
        return number if number in self.graph else None

    def room_payload(self, room_number: Any, radius: int = 1) -> dict[str, Any]:
        room_id = self.resolve(room_number)
        if room_id is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"Room {room_number!r} was not found"}
        room = self.mapper.rooms[room_id]
        exits: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for direction, target_id in room.exits.items():
            target = self.mapper.rooms.get(target_id)
            exits[direction] = {
                "id": target_id,
                "vnum": target.vnum if target else None,
                "name": target.display_name() if target else None,
            }
        radius = max(0, min(20, int(radius)))
        nearby: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if radius:
            undirected = self.graph.to_undirected(as_view=True)
            lengths = nx.single_source_shortest_path_length(undirected, room_id, cutoff=radius)
            for node_id, distance in sorted(lengths.items(), key=lambda pair: (pair[1], pair[0])):
                data = self.graph.nodes[node_id]
                nearby.append({
                    "id": node_id, "vnum": data.get("vnum"), "name": data.get("name"),
                    "terrain": data.get("terrain"), "distance": distance,
                })
        current_distance: int | None = None
        current_id = self.mapper.current_room_id
        if current_id in self.graph:
            try:
                current_distance = nx.shortest_path_length(self.graph.to_undirected(as_view=True), current_id, room_id)
            except (nx.NetworkXNoPath, nx.NodeNotFound):
                pass
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "room": {
                "id": room.id, "vnum": room.vnum, "name": room.display_name(), "fullName": room.name,
                "terrain": room.terrain, "area": room.area,
                "areaName": self.mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area)),
                "coordinates": {"x": room.x, "y": room.y, "z": room.z},
                "note": room.note, "exits": exits,
            },
            "current": room.id == current_id,
            "distanceFromCurrent": current_distance,
            "nearby": nearby,
            "graph": {"nodes": self.graph.number_of_nodes(), "edges": self.graph.number_of_edges()},
        }

    def shortest_path_payload(self, from_number: Any, to_number: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        start = self.resolve(from_number)
        end = self.resolve(to_number)
        if start is None or end is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": "The start or destination room was not found"}
        try:
            path = nx.shortest_path(self.graph, start, end)
        except nx.NetworkXNoPath:
            return {"ok": False, "error": "No directed route exists between those rooms"}
        steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for index, room_id in enumerate(path):
            room = self.mapper.rooms[room_id]
            direction = None
            if index + 1 < len(path):
                direction = self.graph.edges[room_id, path[index + 1]].get("direction")
            steps.append({
                "index": index,
                "id": room.id,
                "vnum": room.vnum,
                "name": room.display_name(),
                "directionToNext": direction,
            })
        return {"ok": True, "length": max(0, len(path) - 1), "steps": steps}


class ZMQRouterService:
    """Local ZeroMQ ROUTER endpoint for map graph queries."""

    def __init__(self, client: "MudClientCore") -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.socket: Any = None
        self.task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self.endpoint = ""

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self.task is not None and not self.task.done()

    async def start(self, endpoint: str | None = None) -> bool:
        if not bool(self.client.profile.data.get("zmqEnabled", True)):
            return False
        if zmq is None:
            await self.client.bus.publish("system.message", text="ZeroMQ disabled: pyzmq is not installed.")
            return False
        endpoint = endpoint or str(self.client.profile.data.get("zmqEndpoint", "tcp://127.0.0.1:5555"))
        if self.running and endpoint == self.endpoint:
            return True
        await self.stop()
        try:
            context = zmq.asyncio.Context.instance()
            self.socket = context.socket(zmq.ROUTER)
            self.socket.setsockopt(zmq.LINGER, 0)
            self.socket.bind(endpoint)
            self.endpoint = endpoint
            self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._serve(), name="ardabest-zmq-router")
            self.client.logger.log("zmq", "started", text=endpoint)
            await self.client.bus.publish("zmq.started", endpoint=endpoint)
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            if self.socket is not None:
                self.socket.close(0)
            self.socket = None
            self.client.logger.log("zmq", "start-error", text=traceback.format_exc(), metadata={"endpoint": endpoint})
            await self.client.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Could not bind ZeroMQ ROUTER at {endpoint}: {exc}")
            return False

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        task, self.task = self.task, None
        if task:
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
                await task
        if self.socket is not None:
            self.socket.close(0)
            self.socket = None
        if self.endpoint:
            self.client.logger.log("zmq", "stopped", text=self.endpoint)
        self.endpoint = ""

    async def _serve(self) -> None:
        assert self.socket is not None
        while True:
            frames = await self.socket.recv_multipart()
            if not frames:
                continue
            payload = frames[-1]
            self.client.logger.log("inbound", "zmq-request", raw=payload)
            try:
                response = await self._handle(payload)
            except Exception:
                response = {"ok": False, "error": "Internal query error", "detail": traceback.format_exc()}
            encoded = json.dumps(response, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8")
            await self.socket.send_multipart(frames[:-1] + [encoded])
            self.client.logger.log("outbound", "zmq-response", text=json.dumps(response, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), raw=encoded)
            await self.client.bus.publish("zmq.query", request=payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ok=bool(response.get("ok")))

    async def _handle(self, payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
        text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
        request: Any
        try:
            request = json.loads(text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            request = text
        if isinstance(request, (int, float)) or (isinstance(request, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+", request)):
            return self.client.map_graph.room_payload(request, radius=1)
        if not isinstance(request, dict):
            return {"ok": False, "error": "Send a room number or a JSON request object"}
        action = str(request.get("action", "query")).lower()
        if action == "ping":
            return {"ok": True, "reply": "pong", "endpoint": self.endpoint}
        if action in {"query", "neighbors", "room"}:
            return self.client.map_graph.room_payload(request.get("room"), radius=int(request.get("radius", 1)))
        if action in {"path", "route"}:
            return self.client.map_graph.shortest_path_payload(request.get("from"), request.get("to"))
        if action in {"locate", "center"}:
            room_id = self.client.map_graph.resolve(request.get("room"))
            if room_id is None:
                return {"ok": False, "error": "Room was not found"}
            self.client.mapper.set_current(room_id)
            room = self.client.mapper.rooms[room_id]
            self.client.map_graph.sync_room(room)
            await self.client.bus.publish(
                "mapper.room", room=room, room_id=room.id, vnum=room.vnum,
                summary=self.client.room_summary(room), source="zmq",
            )
            result = self.client.map_graph.room_payload(room.id, radius=int(request.get("radius", 1)))
            result["located"] = True
            return result
        if action == "graph-info":
            graph = self.client.map_graph.graph
            return {"ok": True, "nodes": graph.number_of_nodes(), "edges": graph.number_of_edges(), "currentRoomId": self.client.mapper.current_room_id}
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Unknown action: {action}"}


class TerminalMapRenderer:
    """Render the NetworkX room graph into an ANSI terminal map."""

    RESET = "\x1b[0m"
    TERRAIN_CODES = {
        "forest": "38;5;34", "wood": "38;5;34", "field": "38;5;70", "grass": "38;5;70",
        "road": "38;5;180", "street": "38;5;180", "city": "38;5;250", "room": "38;5;252",
        "inside": "38;5;252", "water": "38;5;39", "river": "38;5;39", "lake": "38;5;39",
        "mountain": "38;5;244", "hill": "38;5;244", "cave": "38;5;94", "tunnel": "38;5;94",
        "desert": "38;5;214", "swamp": "38;5;64", "snow": "38;5;255", "ice": "38;5;117",
    }

    def __init__(self, adapter: NetworkGraphAdapter) -> None:
        self.adapter = adapter

    def terrain_code(self, terrain: str) -> str:
        lowered = terrain.lower()
        for key, code in self.TERRAIN_CODES.items():
            if key in lowered:
                return code
        return "38;5;246"

    @staticmethod
    def _clip(text: str, width: int) -> str:
        text = strip_ansi(str(text)).replace("\n", " ")
        return text[:width].ljust(width)

    def _relative_positions(self, current_id: int, max_nodes: int) -> dict[int, tuple[int, int]]:
        graph = self.adapter.graph
        positions: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {current_id: (0, 0)}
        occupied: dict[tuple[int, int], int] = {(0, 0): current_id}
        pending: deque[int] = deque([current_id])
        direction_delta = {"n": (0, 1), "s": (0, -1), "e": (1, 0), "w": (-1, 0)}
        while pending and len(positions) < max_nodes:
            source = pending.popleft()
            sx, sy = positions[source]
            edges = list(graph.out_edges(source, data=True))
            edges.sort(key=lambda e: "neswud".find(str(e[2].get("direction", ""))))
            for _, target, data in edges:
                direction = str(data.get("direction", ""))
                if direction not in direction_delta or target in positions:
                    continue
                dx, dy = direction_delta[direction]
                candidate = (sx + dx, sy + dy)
                # Prefer graph geometry; collision nodes are omitted from this compact projection.
                if candidate in occupied:
                    continue
                positions[target] = candidate
                occupied[candidate] = target
                pending.append(target)
                if len(positions) >= max_nodes:
                    break
        return positions

    def render(self, width: int, height: int, mode: str = "medium") -> str:
        width, height = max(20, width), max(5, height)
        current_id = self.adapter.mapper.current_room_id
        if current_id is None or current_id not in self.adapter.graph:
            return "\n".join(["No current room. Enter a room or use /locate ROOM.".center(width)] + [" " * width] * (height - 1))
        mode = mode if mode in {"small", "medium", "large"} else "medium"
        cell_w, cell_h = {"small": (7, 3), "medium": (12, 4), "large": (26, 6)}[mode]
        cols = max(1, width // cell_w)
        rows = max(1, height // cell_h)
        positions = self._relative_positions(current_id, max_nodes=max(9, cols * rows * 3))
        grid = [[" " for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
        color = [["" for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
        priority = [[0 for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
        cx, cy = width // 2, height // 2

        def put(x: int, y: int, value: str, code: str = "", level: int = 1) -> None:
            for offset, char in enumerate(value):
                px = x + offset
                if 0 <= px < width and 0 <= y < height and level >= priority[y][px]:
                    grid[y][px] = char
                    color[y][px] = code
                    priority[y][px] = level

        centers: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {}
        for room_id, (gx, gy) in positions.items():
            x = cx + gx * cell_w
            y = cy - gy * cell_h
            if 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height:
                centers[room_id] = (x, y)

        # Connections first. They are the exit display in compact mode.
        for source, (sx, sy) in centers.items():
            for _, target, data in self.adapter.graph.out_edges(source, data=True):
                if target not in centers:
                    continue
                tx, ty = centers[target]
                direction = str(data.get("direction", ""))
                if direction in {"e", "w"} and sy == ty:
                    for x in range(min(sx, tx) + 1, max(sx, tx)):
                        put(x, sy, "-", "38;5;240", 1)
                elif direction in {"n", "s"} and sx == tx:
                    for y in range(min(sy, ty) + 1, max(sy, ty)):
                        put(sx, y, "|", "38;5;240", 1)

        for room_id, (x, y) in centers.items():
            room = self.adapter.mapper.rooms[room_id]
            exits = "".join(d.upper() for d in "neswud" if d in room.exits) or "-"
            terrain_code = self.terrain_code(room.terrain)
            current = room_id == current_id
            marker = "X" if current else "o"
            marker_code = "1;31" if current else terrain_code
            if mode == "small":
                # Every room exposes exits around the room marker: N/E/S/W plus U/D flags.
                put(x, y, marker, marker_code, 5)
                if "n" in room.exits: put(x, y - 1, "N", terrain_code, 4)
                if "s" in room.exits: put(x, y + 1, "S", terrain_code, 4)
                if "w" in room.exits: put(x - 2, y, "W", terrain_code, 4)
                if "e" in room.exits: put(x + 2, y, "E", terrain_code, 4)
                if "u" in room.exits: put(x - 1, y - 1, "U", terrain_code, 4)
                if "d" in room.exits: put(x + 1, y + 1, "D", terrain_code, 4)
            elif mode == "medium":
                left = x - cell_w // 2 + 1
                put(left, y - 1, self._clip(f"#{room.vnum or room.id}", cell_w - 2), terrain_code, 3)
                put(left, y, self._clip(f"[{marker}] E:{exits}", cell_w - 2), marker_code if current else terrain_code, 5 if current else 3)
                put(left, y + 1, self._clip(room.terrain, cell_w - 2), terrain_code, 3)
            else:
                left = x - cell_w // 2 + 1
                put(left, y - 2, self._clip(room.display_name(), cell_w - 2), terrain_code, 3)
                put(left, y - 1, self._clip(f"#{room.vnum or room.id}  [{room.terrain}]", cell_w - 2), terrain_code, 3)
                put(left, y, self._clip(f"[{marker}] Exits: {exits}", cell_w - 2), marker_code if current else terrain_code, 5 if current else 3)
                area = self.adapter.mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area))
                put(left, y + 1, self._clip(f"Area: {area}", cell_w - 2), terrain_code, 3)
                put(left, y + 2, self._clip(room.note or "", cell_w - 2), "38;5;244", 3)

        lines: list[str] = []
        for y in range(height):
            parts: list[str] = []
            active = ""
            for x in range(width):
                code = color[y][x]
                if code != active:
                    if active:
                        parts.append(self.RESET)
                    if code:
                        parts.append(f"\x1b[{code}m")
                    active = code
                parts.append(grid[y][x])
            if active:
                parts.append(self.RESET)
            lines.append("".join(parts))
        return "\n".join(lines)


class TerminalMapUI:
    """Prompt-toolkit alternate-screen map, with five fixed note lines."""

    MODES = ("small", "medium", "large")

    def __init__(self, client: "MudClientCore", host: str, port: int, auto_connect: bool = True) -> None:
        if Application is None or ANSI is None:
            raise RuntimeError("prompt_toolkit is required. Run the supplied Linux no-root installer.")
        self.client = client
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.auto_connect = auto_connect
        self.renderer = TerminalMapRenderer(client.map_graph)
        self.mode = str(client.profile.data.get("terminalMapMode", "medium"))
        if self.mode not in self.MODES:
            self.mode = "medium"
        self.last_line = "Ready"
        self.last_system = ""
        self._tokens: list[str] = []
        self._closing = False
        self.map_control = FormattedTextControl(text=self._map_text, focusable=False)
        self.status_control = FormattedTextControl(text=self._status_text, focusable=False)
        self.notes_control = FormattedTextControl(text=self._notes_text, focusable=False)
        self.input = TextArea(height=1, prompt="> ", multiline=False, accept_handler=self._accept)
        kb = KeyBindings()

        @kb.add("f2")
        def _cycle(event: Any) -> None:
            self.cycle_mode()

        @kb.add("f3")
        def _small(event: Any) -> None:
            self.set_mode("small")

        @kb.add("f4")
        def _medium(event: Any) -> None:
            self.set_mode("medium")

        @kb.add("f5")
        def _large(event: Any) -> None:
            self.set_mode("large")

        @kb.add("c-c")
        @kb.add("c-q")
        def _quit(event: Any) -> None:
            self._closing = True
            event.app.exit()

        body = HSplit([
            Window(content=self.map_control, wrap_lines=False, always_hide_cursor=True),
            Window(height=1, content=self.status_control),
            Window(height=5, content=self.notes_control, wrap_lines=False),
            self.input,
        ])
        self.app = Application(layout=Layout(body, focused_element=self.input), key_bindings=kb, full_screen=True, mouse_support=False)

    def _size(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        size = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
        return max(80, size.columns), max(24, size.lines)

    def _map_text(self) -> Any:
        width, rows = self._size()
        map_height = max(5, rows - 7)
        return ANSI(self.renderer.render(width, map_height, self.mode))

    def _status_text(self) -> Any:
        room = self.client.mapper.rooms.get(self.client.mapper.current_room_id) if self.client.mapper.current_room_id is not None else None
        room_number = room.vnum or room.id if room else "?"
        connected = "CONNECTED" if self.client.connection.connected else "OFFLINE"
        endpoint = self.client.zmq_service.endpoint or str(self.client.profile.data.get("zmqEndpoint", "disabled"))
        text = f" {connected} {self.host}:{self.port} | MAP:{self.mode.upper()} F2 cycle F3/F4/F5 size | ROOM:{room_number} | ZMQ:{endpoint} "
        return FormattedText([("reverse", self._fit(text))])

    def _fit(self, text: str) -> str:
        width, _ = self._size()
        return strip_ansi(text)[:width].ljust(width)

    def _notes_text(self) -> Any:
        mapper = self.client.mapper
        room = mapper.rooms.get(mapper.current_room_id) if mapper.current_room_id is not None else None
        if room:
            area = mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area))
            exit_parts = []
            for direction in "neswud":
                target_id = room.exits.get(direction)
                if target_id is None:
                    continue
                target = mapper.rooms.get(target_id)
                exit_parts.append(f"{direction.upper()}:{target.vnum if target and target.vnum is not None else target_id}")
            lines = [
                f"ROOM  {self.client.room_summary(room)}",
                f"AREA  {area} | internal={room.id} | xyz=({room.x},{room.y},{room.z})",
                f"EXITS {'  '.join(exit_parts) if exit_parts else 'none'}",
                f"NOTE  {room.note or '(use /note TEXT to save a note on this room)'}",
                f"LAST  {self.last_system or self.last_line or 'Ready'}",
            ]
        else:
            lines = [
                "ROOM  No current room",
                "AREA  -",
                "EXITS -",
                "NOTE  Enter the game or use /locate ROOM",
                f"LAST  {self.last_system or self.last_line or 'Ready'}",
            ]
        return ANSI("\n".join(self._fit(line) for line in lines[:5]))

    def _accept(self, buffer: Any) -> bool:
        command = buffer.text.strip()
        buffer.text = ""
        if command:
            asyncio.create_task(self.client.send(command))
        return True

    def set_mode(self, mode: str) -> None:
        if mode not in self.MODES:
            return
        self.mode = mode
        self.client.profile.data["terminalMapMode"] = mode
        self.client.profile.save()
        self.app.invalidate()

    def cycle_mode(self) -> None:
        self.set_mode(self.MODES[(self.MODES.index(self.mode) + 1) % len(self.MODES)])

    def _event(self, topic: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        if topic == "network.text":
            lines = [line.strip() for line in strip_ansi(str(payload.get("text", ""))).replace("\r", "\n").split("\n") if line.strip()]
            if lines:
                self.last_line = lines[-1]
        elif topic == "system.message":
            self.last_system = strip_ansi(str(payload.get("text", ""))).replace("\n", " | ")
        elif topic == "connection.connected":
            self.last_system = f"Connected to {payload.get('host', self.host)}:{payload.get('port', self.port)}"
        elif topic == "connection.disconnected":
            self.last_system = f"Disconnected: {payload.get('reason', 'connection closed')}"
        elif topic == "script.error":
            self.last_system = f"SCRIPT ERROR: {payload.get('path')}"
        elif topic == "terminal.map-mode":
            mode = str(payload.get("mode", ""))
            if mode in self.MODES:
                self.mode = mode
        elif topic == "client.quit-requested":
            self._closing = True
            self.app.exit()
            return
        if not self._closing:
            self.app.invalidate()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        columns, lines = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
        if columns < 80 or lines < 24:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Terminal map needs at least 80x24; current terminal is {columns}x{lines}.")
        await self.client.startup()
        self._tokens.append(self.client.bus.subscribe("*", self._event))
        if self.auto_connect:
            try:
                await self.client.connect(self.host, self.port)
            except Exception:
                self.last_system = "Initial connection failed; use /connect to retry."
        try:
            await self.app.run_async()
        finally:
            self._closing = True
            for token in self._tokens:
                self.client.bus.unsubscribe(token)
            await self.client.shutdown()



class MudClientCore:
    def __init__(self, profile_dir: Path, ui_queue: queue.Queue[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] | None = None) -> None:
        self.profile = Profile(profile_dir)
        logs_dir = profile_dir / "logs"
        log_name = datetime.now().strftime("traffic-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.xml")
        self.logger = XMLTrafficLogger(logs_dir / log_name)
        self.bus = EventBus(self.logger)
        self.ui_queue = ui_queue
        self.variables = VariableStore(profile_dir / "variables.json")
        self.automation = AutomationRegistry(self)
        self.mapper = MapperModel(profile_dir, self.logger)
        self.map_graph = NetworkGraphAdapter(self.mapper, self.logger)
        self.connection = AsyncTelnetConnection(self)
        self.scripts = ScriptManager(self, profile_dir / "scripts")
        self.zmq_service = ZMQRouterService(self)
        self._line_buffer = ""
        self._last_prompt_processed = ""
        self._active_script_owner = "user"
        self._owner_tokens: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self._loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop | None = None
        self._install_builtin_automation()
        if ui_queue is not None:
            self.bus.subscribe("*", self._bridge_to_ui)

    @property
    def profile_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.profile.dir

    @property
    def xml_log_path(self) -> Path:
        return self.logger.path

    def set_loop(self, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
        self._loop = loop

    def _bridge_to_ui(self, topic: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        if self.ui_queue is None:
            return
        safe_payload = dict(payload)
        self.ui_queue.put((topic, safe_payload))

    def alias(self, pattern: str, callback: AliasCallback | None = None, **kwargs: Any):
        kwargs.setdefault("owner", self._active_script_owner)
        return self.automation.alias(pattern, callback, **kwargs)

    def trigger(self, pattern: str, callback: TriggerCallback | None = None, **kwargs: Any):
        kwargs.setdefault("owner", self._active_script_owner)
        return self.automation.trigger(pattern, callback, **kwargs)

    def subscribe(self, topic: str, callback: EventCallback) -> str:
        token = self.bus.subscribe(topic, callback)
        self._owner_tokens.setdefault(self._active_script_owner, []).append(token)
        return token

    def unsubscribe_owner(self, owner: str) -> None:
        for token in self._owner_tokens.pop(owner, []):
            self.bus.unsubscribe(token)

    async def publish(self, topic: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        await self.bus.publish(topic, **payload)

    def system(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.logger.log("system", "message", text=text)
        if self._loop and self._loop.is_running():
            asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self.bus.publish("system.message", text=text), self._loop)

    async def startup(self) -> None:
        await self.scripts.reload()
        await self.zmq_service.start()
        await self.bus.publish(
            "client.ready", profile=str(self.profile_dir), xml_log=str(self.xml_log_path),
            graph_nodes=self.map_graph.graph.number_of_nodes(), graph_edges=self.map_graph.graph.number_of_edges(),
            zmq_endpoint=self.zmq_service.endpoint,
        )

    async def connect(self, host: str | None = None, port: int | None = None) -> None:
        host = host or str(self.profile.data.get("host", DEFAULT_HOST))
        port = int(port or self.profile.data.get("port", DEFAULT_PORT))
        self.profile.data.update({"host": host, "port": port})
        self.profile.save()
        await self.connection.connect(host, port)

    async def disconnect(self) -> None:
        await self.connection.disconnect("user")

    async def send(self, command: str) -> None:
        command = str(command)
        if not command.strip():
            return
        if command.startswith("/"):
            await self.handle_local_command(command)
            return
        lowered = command.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"start mapping", "mapping on"}:
            self.mapper.mapping_enabled = True
            self.mapper.save()
            await self.bus.publish("mapper.mode", enabled=True)
            return
        if lowered in {"stop mapping", "mapping off"}:
            self.mapper.mapping_enabled = False
            self.mapper.save()
            await self.bus.publish("mapper.mode", enabled=False)
            return
        if lowered == "save map":
            self.mapper.save()
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Map saved to {self.mapper.custom_path}")
            return
        if await self.automation.process_alias(command):
            return
        self.mapper.remember_move(command)
        if not self.connection.connected:
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text="Not connected. Use /connect or the Connect button.")
            return
        await self.connection.send_line(command)
        await self.bus.publish("command.sent", command=command)

    async def receive_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        await self.bus.publish("network.text", text=text)
        self._line_buffer += text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
        while "\n" in self._line_buffer:
            line, self._line_buffer = self._line_buffer.split("\n", 1)
            plain = strip_ansi(line)
            await self.bus.publish("network.line", line=plain, raw_line=line)
            room = self.mapper.detect_room_line(plain)
            if room:
                self.map_graph.sync_room(room)
                await self.bus.publish("mapper.room", room=room, room_id=room.id, vnum=room.vnum, summary=self.room_summary(room), source="telnet")
            await self.automation.process_line(plain, raw_block=line)
            if plain == self._last_prompt_processed:
                self._last_prompt_processed = ""
        # Prompts often do not end with newline; process each distinct prompt once.
        if self._line_buffer and (self._line_buffer.endswith("]>") or self._line_buffer.endswith(">")):
            prompt = strip_ansi(self._line_buffer)
            await self.bus.publish("network.prompt", text=prompt)
            if prompt != self._last_prompt_processed:
                self._last_prompt_processed = prompt
                await self.automation.process_line(prompt, raw_block=self._line_buffer)

    def room_summary(self, room: Room | None = None) -> str:
        room = room or (self.mapper.rooms.get(self.mapper.current_room_id) if self.mapper.current_room_id is not None else None)
        if not room:
            return "No current room"
        visible_exits = room.observed_exits or [direction for direction in ("n", "e", "s", "w", "u", "d") if direction in room.exits]
        exits = " ".join(direction.upper() for direction in visible_exits) or "none"
        return f"{room.display_name()} (#{room.vnum or room.id}) [{room.terrain}] Exits are: {exits}"

    async def handle_local_command(self, command: str) -> None:
        parts = command[1:].strip().split()
        if not parts:
            return
        name = parts[0].lower()
        args = parts[1:]
        if name == "connect":
            host = args[0] if args else None
            port = int(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else None
            await self.connect(host, port)
        elif name == "disconnect":
            await self.disconnect()
        elif name == "reload":
            ok = await self.scripts.reload()
            if not ok:
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text="Python automation reload was not applied.")
        elif name == "set" and len(args) >= 2:
            key = args[0]
            raw_value = " ".join(args[1:])
            try:
                value = json.loads(raw_value)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                value = raw_value
            self.variables.set(key, value)
            await self.bus.publish("variable.changed", key=key, value=value)
        elif name == "get" and args:
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"{args[0]} = {self.variables.get(args[0])!r}")
        elif name == "vars":
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=json.dumps(self.variables, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
        elif name == "aliases":
            text = "\n".join(f"{r.name}: {r.pattern_text} ({'ON' if r.enabled else 'OFF'})" for r in self.automation.aliases)
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=text or "No aliases registered.")
        elif name == "triggers":
            text = "\n".join(f"{r.name}: {r.pattern_text} ({'ON' if r.enabled else 'OFF'})" for r in self.automation.triggers)
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=text or "No triggers registered.")
        elif name == "mapping" and args:
            enabled = args[0].lower() in {"1", "on", "yes", "true", "start"}
            self.mapper.mapping_enabled = enabled
            self.mapper.save()
            await self.bus.publish("mapper.mode", enabled=enabled)
        elif name == "save" and args and args[0].lower() == "map":
            self.mapper.save()
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Map saved to {self.mapper.custom_path}")
        elif name == "find" and args:
