            results = self.mapper.search(" ".join(args), 30)
            text = "\n".join(f"#{r.vnum or r.id}: {r.display_name()} [{self.mapper.areas.get(r.area, r.area)}]" for r in results)
            await self.bus.publish("mapper.search-results", results=results, text=text or "No rooms found.")
        elif name == "map" and args:
            mode = args[0].lower()
            if mode not in {"small", "medium", "large"}:
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text="Map mode must be small, medium, or large.")
            else:
                self.profile.data["terminalMapMode"] = mode
                self.profile.save()
                await self.bus.publish("terminal.map-mode", mode=mode)
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Terminal map mode set to {mode}.")
        elif name == "note":
            room = self.mapper.rooms.get(self.mapper.current_room_id) if self.mapper.current_room_id is not None else None
            if not room:
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text="No current room to annotate.")
            else:
                room.note = " ".join(args).strip()
                self.mapper.modified_ids.add(room.id)
                self.mapper.save()
                self.map_graph.sync_room(room)
                await self.bus.publish("mapper.room", room=room, room_id=room.id, vnum=room.vnum, summary=self.room_summary(room), source="note")
        elif name == "locate" and args:
            room_id = self.map_graph.resolve(args[0])
            if room_id is None:
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Room {args[0]} was not found.")
            else:
                self.mapper.set_current(room_id)
                room = self.mapper.rooms[room_id]
                await self.bus.publish("mapper.room", room=room, room_id=room.id, vnum=room.vnum, summary=self.room_summary(room), source="local")
        elif name == "path" and len(args) >= 2:
            result = self.map_graph.shortest_path_payload(args[0], args[1])
            if result.get("ok"):
                lines = [f"{step['index']:>3}: #{step['vnum'] or step['id']} {step['name']} -> {step['directionToNext'] or 'END'}" for step in result["steps"]]
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Route length: {result['length']}\n" + "\n".join(lines))
            else:
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=str(result.get("error")))
        elif name == "zmq":
            action = args[0].lower() if args else "status"
            if action == "status":
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"ZeroMQ ROUTER: {self.zmq_service.endpoint or 'stopped'}")
            elif action == "off":
                self.profile.data["zmqEnabled"] = False
                self.profile.save()
                await self.zmq_service.stop()
                await self.bus.publish("system.message", text="ZeroMQ ROUTER stopped.")
            elif action == "on":
                self.profile.data["zmqEnabled"] = True
                self.profile.save()
                await self.zmq_service.start()
            else:
                endpoint = " ".join(args)
                self.profile.data.update({"zmqEnabled": True, "zmqEndpoint": endpoint})
                self.profile.save()
                await self.zmq_service.start(endpoint)
        elif name == "xml":
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"XML traffic log: {self.xml_log_path}")
        elif name == "scripts":
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Python scripts folder: {self.scripts.scripts_dir}")
        elif name == "help":
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=self.help_text())
        elif name in {"quitclient", "exitclient"}:
            await self.bus.publish("client.quit-requested")
        else:
            await self.bus.publish("system.message", text=f"Unknown local command: {command}\nUse /help")

    def help_text(self) -> str:
        return (
            "Local commands:\n"
            "  /connect [host] [port]   /disconnect\n"
            "  /reload                  reload profile/scripts/*.py\n"
            "  /set NAME VALUE          VALUE may be JSON\n"
            "  /get NAME                /vars\n"
            "  /aliases                 /triggers\n"
            "  /mapping on|off          /save map\n"
            "  /find TEXT               search embedded map\n"
            "  /map small|medium|large  terminal map detail level\n"
            "  /note TEXT               save a note on the current room\n"
            "  /locate ROOM             center map on vnum or internal room id\n"
            "  /path FROM TO            shortest directed NetworkX route\n"
            "  /zmq status|on|off|ENDPOINT  control the ROUTER socket\n"
            "  /xml                     show XML log path\n"
            "  /scripts                 show Python scripts folder\n"
            "  /quitclient              close the application\n"
            "Normal input is processed by Python aliases, then sent to the MUD."
        )

    def _install_builtin_automation(self) -> None:
        @self.trigger(ROOM_LINE_RE.pattern, name="RotS Automapper", flags=re.IGNORECASE, priority=1000, owner="builtin")
        async def _automapper_trigger(ctx: TriggerContext) -> None:
            # Room detection already occurs before user triggers; this event is useful to scripts.
            room = self.mapper.room_for_vnum(int(ctx.match.group("vnum")))
            if room:
                await self.bus.publish("automapper.trigger", room_id=room.id, vnum=room.vnum)

        @self.trigger(r"\[HP:\s*(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+)(?:\s+S:\s*(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+))?(?:\s+MV:\s*(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+))?", name="Status Prompt", priority=900, owner="builtin")
        async def _status_trigger(ctx: TriggerContext) -> None:
            values = [int(value) if value else None for value in ctx.match.groups()]
            await self.bus.publish(
                "status.update", hp=values[0], hp_max=values[1], mana=values[2], mana_max=values[3],
                movement=values[4], movement_max=values[5],
            )

        @self.trigger(r"need\s+([\d,]+)\s+(?:experience|xp)", name="XP Needed", priority=800, owner="builtin")
        async def _xp_need(ctx: TriggerContext) -> None:
            need = int(ctx.match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
            self.variables["xp_need"] = need
            self.variables.setdefault("xp_total", need)
            self.variables.save()
            await self.bus.publish("xp.update", need=need, total=self.variables.get("xp_total", need))

        @self.trigger(r"You receive(?: your share of)? experience\s*(?:--|—|-)?\s*([\d,]+)\s+points", name="XP Gain", priority=800, owner="builtin")
        async def _xp_gain(ctx: TriggerContext) -> None:
            gained = int(ctx.match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
            current_need = self.variables.get("xp_need")
            if isinstance(current_need, int):
                total = int(self.variables.get("xp_total", current_need + gained))
                need = max(0, current_need - gained)
                self.variables["xp_need"] = need
                self.variables["xp_total"] = max(total, current_need)
                self.variables.save()
                await self.bus.publish("xp.update", need=need, total=self.variables["xp_total"], gained=gained)
            else:
                await self.bus.publish("xp.gain", gained=gained)

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await self.zmq_service.stop()
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await self.disconnect()
        self.variables.save()
        self.mapper.save()
        self.profile.save()
        await self.bus.publish("client.stopped")


class AsyncRuntime:
    def __init__(self, client: MudClientCore) -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, name="ArdaBestAsyncLoop", daemon=True)
        self.started = threading.Event()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        asyncio.set_event_loop(self.loop)
        self.client.set_loop(self.loop)
        self.started.set()
        self.loop.run_forever()
        pending = asyncio.all_tasks(self.loop)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        if pending:
            self.loop.run_until_complete(asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True))
        self.loop.close()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.thread.start()
        self.started.wait(5)
        self.submit(self.client.startup())

    def submit(self, coroutine: Awaitable[Any]):
        return asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coroutine, self.loop)

    def stop(self) -> None:
        if not self.loop.is_running():
            return
        future = self.submit(self.client.shutdown())
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            future.result(timeout=5)
        self.loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self.loop.stop)
        self.thread.join(timeout=5)


if tk is not None:
    class AnsiTextRenderer:
        BASE_COLORS = {
            30: "#000000", 31: "#cc3333", 32: "#33cc66", 33: "#cccc33",
            34: "#4b6fff", 35: "#cc55cc", 36: "#33cccc", 37: "#dddddd",
            90: "#666666", 91: "#ff5555", 92: "#55ff88", 93: "#ffff55",
            94: "#7799ff", 95: "#ff77ff", 96: "#55ffff", 97: "#ffffff",
        }

        def __init__(self, widget: tk.Text) -> None:
            self.widget = widget
            self.foreground = "#dddddd"
            self.bold = False
            self._tag_cache: dict[tuple[str, bool], str] = {}

        def _tag(self) -> str:
            key = (self.foreground, self.bold)
            if key not in self._tag_cache:
                tag = f"ansi_{len(self._tag_cache)}"
                self.widget.tag_configure(tag, foreground=self.foreground, font=("TkFixedFont", 10, "bold" if self.bold else "normal"))
                self._tag_cache[key] = tag
            return self._tag_cache[key]

        def append(self, text: str) -> None:
            pos = 0
            for match in ANSI_RE.finditer(text):
                if match.start() > pos:
                    self.widget.insert("end", text[pos:match.start()], self._tag())
                self._apply(match.group())
                pos = match.end()
            if pos < len(text):
                self.widget.insert("end", text[pos:], self._tag())
            self.widget.see("end")

        def _apply(self, sequence: str) -> None:
            if not sequence.endswith("m"):
                return
            body = sequence[2:-1]
            codes = [int(part) if part else 0 for part in body.split(";")]
            for code in codes:
                if code == 0:
                    self.foreground = "#dddddd"
                    self.bold = False
                elif code == 1:
                    self.bold = True
                elif code == 22:
                    self.bold = False
                elif code in self.BASE_COLORS:
                    self.foreground = self.BASE_COLORS[code]


    class MapCanvas(tk.Canvas):
        def __init__(self, master: tk.Misc, model: MapperModel, on_status: Callable[[str], None], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
            super().__init__(master, background="#020805", highlightthickness=0, **kwargs)
            self.model = model
            self.on_status = on_status
            self.zoom = 1.0
            self.room_shape = "square"
            self.show_names = False
            self.show_grid = True
            # Controls how much text is drawn beside each room.  The GUI uses
            # the same small/medium/large meaning as the alternate terminal map:
            # small=max rooms, medium=exit letters, large=name/terrain/exits.
            self.detail_mode = "medium"
            self.area = 1
            self.z = 0
            self.center_x = 0.0
            self.center_y = 0.0
            self.drag_start: tuple[int, int] | None = None
            self.room_items: dict[int, int] = {}
            self.bind("<Configure>", lambda _e: self.redraw())
            self.bind("<MouseWheel>", self._wheel)
            self.bind("<Button-4>", lambda e: self._zoom_at(1.15, e.x, e.y))
            self.bind("<Button-5>", lambda e: self._zoom_at(1 / 1.15, e.x, e.y))
            self.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._press)
            self.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._drag)
            self.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._release)
            self.bind("<Button-3>", self._context)

        def focus_current(self) -> None:
            room = self.model.rooms.get(self.model.current_room_id) if self.model.current_room_id is not None else None
            if not room:
                self.focus_overview()
                return
            self.area, self.z = room.area, room.z
            self.center_x, self.center_y = room.x, room.y
            # Keep enough neighboring rooms visible while still making the red X obvious.
            self.zoom = max(0.45, min(self.zoom, 1.35))
            self.redraw()

        def focus_overview(self) -> None:
            """Show a real map immediately, even before RotS reports the player room."""
            counts: dict[tuple[int, int], int] = {}
            for room in self.model.rooms.values():
                if room.deleted:
                    continue
                key = (room.area, room.z)
                counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
            if not counts:
                self.redraw()
                return
            self.area, self.z = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            rooms = self.model.visible_rooms(self.area, self.z)
            if not rooms:
                self.redraw()
                return
            min_x = min(room.x for room in rooms)
            max_x = max(room.x for room in rooms)
            min_y = min(room.y for room in rooms)
            max_y = max(room.y for room in rooms)
            self.center_x = (min_x + max_x) / 2
            self.center_y = (min_y + max_y) / 2
            width = max(320, self.winfo_width())
            height = max(240, self.winfo_height())
            fit_x = width / (max(2.0, max_x - min_x + 3.0) * 34.0)
            fit_y = height / (max(2.0, max_y - min_y + 3.0) * 34.0)
            self.zoom = max(0.20, min(1.20, fit_x, fit_y))
            self.redraw()

        @staticmethod
        def terrain_color(room: Room) -> str:
            if room.color:
                return room.color
            value = f"{room.terrain} {room.name}".lower()
            rules = (
                (("forest", "wood", "grove"), "#176b2c"),
                (("field", "plain", "grass"), "#557a2d"),
                (("road", "street", "path"), "#74634b"),
                (("cave", "tunnel", "mine", "underground"), "#574d63"),
                (("mountain", "hill", "rock"), "#666d73"),
                (("water", "river", "lake", "sea", "shore"), "#165c8a"),
                (("city", "inside", "building", "room"), "#66532f"),
                (("swamp", "marsh"), "#486236"),
                (("desert", "sand"), "#8a6d32"),
                (("snow", "ice"), "#617b86"),
            )
            for needles, color in rules:
                if any(needle in value for needle in needles):
                    return color
            return "#153c29"

        def _world_to_screen(self, x: float, y: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
            scale = 34 * self.zoom
            return self.winfo_width() / 2 + (x - self.center_x) * scale, self.winfo_height() / 2 - (y - self.center_y) * scale

        def _screen_to_world(self, x: float, y: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
            scale = 34 * self.zoom
            return self.center_x + (x - self.winfo_width() / 2) / scale, self.center_y - (y - self.winfo_height() / 2) / scale

        def redraw(self) -> None:
            self.delete("all")
            self.room_items.clear()
            rooms = self.model.visible_rooms(self.area, self.z)
            if self.show_grid:
                self._draw_grid()
            room_ids = {room.id for room in rooms}
            for room in rooms:
                x1, y1 = self._world_to_screen(room.x, room.y)
                for direction, destination in room.exits.items():
                    if destination not in room_ids or destination < room.id:
                        continue
                    other = self.model.rooms.get(destination)
                    if not other:
                        continue
                    x2, y2 = self._world_to_screen(other.x, other.y)
                    self.create_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill="#00aa55", width=max(1, int(2 * self.zoom)))
            radius = max(5, 12 * self.zoom)
            for room in rooms:
                x, y = self._world_to_screen(room.x, room.y)
                current = room.id == self.model.current_room_id
                fill = self.terrain_color(room)
                outline = "#ff5555" if current else "#00dd66"
                width = 4 if current else 2
                tags = (f"room:{room.id}", "room")
                if self.room_shape == "circle":
                    item = self.create_oval(x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width, tags=tags)
                else:
                    item = self.create_rectangle(x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width, tags=tags)
                self.room_items[room.id] = item
                self.create_text(x, y, text=self.model.emoji_for(room), fill="#ffffff", font=("TkDefaultFont", max(7, int(10*self.zoom))), tags=tags)
                if current:
                    self.create_text(x, y, text="X", fill="#ff2020", font=("TkFixedFont", max(10, int(16*self.zoom)), "bold"), tags=tags)

                # E means exits.  Keep small mode uncluttered, show exit letters
                # in medium mode, and show room name, terrain, and exits in large
                # mode.  The five-line information panel below the map always
                # shows the complete current-room details.
                exit_source = room.observed_exits or list(room.exits.keys())
                ordered_exits = [d.upper() for d in ("n", "e", "s", "w", "u", "d") if d in exit_source]
                exits_text = "".join(ordered_exits) or "-"
                if self.detail_mode == "medium" and self.zoom >= 0.50:
                    label = f"E:{exits_text}"
                    self.create_text(
                        x, y + radius + 8, text=label, fill="#8fffc0",
                        font=("TkFixedFont", max(6, int(7 * self.zoom))), tags=tags
                    )
                elif self.detail_mode == "large" and self.zoom >= 0.72:
                    terrain = room.terrain or "Unknown"
                    label = f"{room.display_name()[:28]}\n[{terrain[:20]}]  E:{exits_text}"
                    self.create_text(
                        x, y + radius + 15, text=label, fill="#aaffcc", justify="center",
                        font=("TkFixedFont", max(7, int(8 * self.zoom))), tags=tags
                    )
                elif self.show_names:
                    self.create_text(x, y + radius + 9, text=room.display_name()[:30], fill="#aaffcc", font=("TkDefaultFont", max(6, int(8*self.zoom))), tags=tags)
            area_name = self.model.areas.get(self.area, str(self.area))
            self.create_text(10, 10, anchor="nw", text=f"{area_name} — Z {self.z} — {len(rooms)} rooms", fill="#55ff99")

        def _draw_grid(self) -> None:
            scale = 34 * self.zoom
            if scale < 12:
                return
            left, top = self._screen_to_world(0, 0)
            right, bottom = self._screen_to_world(self.winfo_width(), self.winfo_height())
            min_x, max_x = int(min(left, right))-1, int(max(left, right))+1
            min_y, max_y = int(min(top, bottom))-1, int(max(top, bottom))+1
            for wx in range(min_x, max_x + 1):
                x, _ = self._world_to_screen(wx, 0)
                self.create_line(x, 0, x, self.winfo_height(), fill="#062015")
            for wy in range(min_y, max_y + 1):
                _, y = self._world_to_screen(0, wy)
                self.create_line(0, y, self.winfo_width(), y, fill="#062015")

        def _wheel(self, event: tk.Event) -> None:
            factor = 1.15 if event.delta > 0 else 1/1.15
            self._zoom_at(factor, event.x, event.y)

        def _zoom_at(self, factor: float, x: int, y: int) -> None:
            before = self._screen_to_world(x, y)
            self.zoom = max(0.2, min(4.0, self.zoom * factor))
            after = self._screen_to_world(x, y)
            self.center_x += before[0] - after[0]
            self.center_y += before[1] - after[1]
            self.redraw()

        def _press(self, event: tk.Event) -> None:
            self.drag_start = (event.x, event.y)
            room_id = self._room_at(event.x, event.y)
            if room_id is not None:
                room = self.model.rooms[room_id]
                self.on_status(f"{room.display_name()}  #{room.vnum or room.id}  [{room.terrain}]  {room.note}")

        def _drag(self, event: tk.Event) -> None:
            if not self.drag_start:
                return
            dx = event.x - self.drag_start[0]
            dy = event.y - self.drag_start[1]
            scale = 34 * self.zoom
            self.center_x -= dx / scale
            self.center_y += dy / scale
            self.drag_start = (event.x, event.y)
            self.redraw()

        def _release(self, _event: tk.Event) -> None:
            self.drag_start = None

        def _room_at(self, x: int, y: int) -> int | None:
            items = self.find_overlapping(x-2, y-2, x+2, y+2)
            for item in reversed(items):
                for tag in self.gettags(item):
                    if tag.startswith("room:"):
                        return int(tag.split(":", 1)[1])
            return None

        def _context(self, event: tk.Event) -> None:
            room_id = self._room_at(event.x, event.y)
            if room_id is None:
                return
            room = self.model.rooms[room_id]
            menu = tk.Menu(self, tearoff=False)
            menu.add_command(label="Set player location", command=lambda: self._set_current(room_id))
            menu.add_command(label="Change emoji", command=lambda: self._change_emoji(room))
            menu.add_command(label="Change color", command=lambda: self._change_color(room))
            menu.add_command(label="Edit note", command=lambda: self._edit_note(room))
            menu.add_separator()
            menu.add_command(label="Delete custom room", command=lambda: self._delete_room(room))
            menu.tk_popup(event.x_root, event.y_root)

        def _set_current(self, room_id: int) -> None:
            self.model.set_current(room_id)
            self.focus_current()

        def _change_emoji(self, room: Room) -> None:
            value = simpledialog.askstring("Room emoji", "Emoji or short text:", initialvalue=room.emoji or self.model.emoji_for(room), parent=self)
            if value is not None:
                room.emoji = value.strip()
                self.model.modified_ids.add(room.id)
                self.model.save()
                self.redraw()

        def _change_color(self, room: Room) -> None:
            _, value = colorchooser.askcolor(color=room.color or "#052b17", parent=self)
            if value:
                room.color = value
                self.model.modified_ids.add(room.id)
                self.model.save()
                self.redraw()

        def _edit_note(self, room: Room) -> None:
            value = simpledialog.askstring("Room note", "Room label/details:", initialvalue=room.note, parent=self)
            if value is not None:
                room.note = value
                self.model.modified_ids.add(room.id)
                self.model.save()
                self.redraw()

        def _delete_room(self, room: Room) -> None:
            if room.id >= 0:
                messagebox.showinfo("Built-in room", "Built-in rooms are hidden rather than physically removed.", parent=self)
            room.deleted = True
            self.model.modified_ids.add(room.id)
            for other in self.model.rooms.values():
                before = len(other.exits)
                other.exits = {d: rid for d, rid in other.exits.items() if rid != room.id}
                if len(other.exits) != before:
                    self.model.modified_ids.add(other.id)
            self.model.save()
            self.redraw()


    class MudClientGUI:
        """Desktop UI modeled after the original ArdaBest client.

        The MUD terminal remains visible on the left while the NetworkX-backed
        mapper remains visible on the right. The divider is draggable.
        """

        def __init__(
            self,
            root: tk.Tk,
            client: MudClientCore,
            runtime: AsyncRuntime,
            ui_queue: queue.Queue[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]],
            host: str,
            port: int,
            auto_connect: bool = True,
        ) -> None:
            self.root = root
            self.client = client
            self.runtime = runtime
            self.ui_queue = ui_queue
            self.default_host = host
            self.default_port = port
            self.history: list[str] = []
            self.history_index = 0
            self.map_mode = tk.StringVar(value=str(self.client.profile.data.get("guiMapMode", "medium")))
            self.root.title(f"{APP_NAME} — {DEFAULT_HOST}:{DEFAULT_PORT}")
            # Keep the whole window inside the usable desktop. A hard-coded 1600x900
            # client area could push the command entry below the bottom edge on a
            # 1600x900 display once the desktop title bar/panel is included.
            screen_w = max(1024, int(self.root.winfo_screenwidth()))
            screen_h = max(700, int(self.root.winfo_screenheight()))
            window_w = min(1600, max(1050, screen_w - 70))
            window_h = min(900, max(650, screen_h - 120))
            x = max(0, (screen_w - window_w) // 2)
            y = max(0, (screen_h - window_h) // 3)
            self.root.geometry(f"{window_w}x{window_h}+{x}+{y}")
            self.root.minsize(1000, 620)
            self.root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.close)
            self.root.bind_all("<Control-l>", self._focus_command_entry)
            self._configure_styles()
            self._build()
            self._refresh_automation()
            self._populate_rooms("")
            self.root.after(40, self._poll_events)
            self.root.after(250, self._initial_map_view)
            if auto_connect:
                self.root.after(700, self.connect)

        def _configure_styles(self) -> None:
            style = ttk.Style(self.root)
            with contextlib.suppress(tk.TclError):
                style.theme_use("clam")
            style.configure("Health.Horizontal.TProgressbar", background="#c83333", troughcolor="#dedede")
            style.configure("Mana.Horizontal.TProgressbar", background="#305fd0", troughcolor="#dedede")
            style.configure("Movement.Horizontal.TProgressbar", background="#d2b32b", troughcolor="#dedede")
            style.configure("XP.Horizontal.TProgressbar", background="#2f9b4e", troughcolor="#dedede")
            style.configure("Connected.TLabel", foreground="#00884a")
            style.configure("Disconnected.TLabel", foreground="#aa2222")

        def _build(self) -> None:
            # File/action toolbar, similar to the original Qt client.
            action_bar = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=(6, 4))
            action_bar.pack(fill="x")
            ttk.Button(action_bar, text="💾 Save profile", command=self._save_profile).pack(side="left")
            ttk.Button(action_bar, text="🧹 Clear terminal", command=self._clear_terminal).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Button(action_bar, text="🐍 Reload Python", command=self._reload_python).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Button(action_bar, text="📁 Scripts folder", command=lambda: open_folder(self.client.scripts.scripts_dir)).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Button(action_bar, text="🧾 XML logs", command=lambda: open_folder(self.client.xml_log_path.parent)).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            self.connection_label = ttk.Label(action_bar, text="Disconnected", style="Disconnected.TLabel")
            self.connection_label.pack(side="right")

            connection_bar = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=(6, 3))
            connection_bar.pack(fill="x")
            ttk.Label(connection_bar, text="🌐 Host:").pack(side="left")
            self.host_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(self.client.profile.data.get("host", self.default_host)))
            ttk.Entry(connection_bar, textvariable=self.host_var, width=25).pack(side="left", padx=(3, 9))
            ttk.Label(connection_bar, text="Port:").pack(side="left")
            self.port_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(self.client.profile.data.get("port", self.default_port)))
            ttk.Entry(connection_bar, textvariable=self.port_var, width=8).pack(side="left", padx=(3, 9))
            ttk.Button(connection_bar, text="Connect", command=self.connect).pack(side="left")
            ttk.Button(connection_bar, text="Disconnect", command=lambda: self.runtime.submit(self.client.disconnect())).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Label(connection_bar, text="Default: rotsmud.org:3791").pack(side="left", padx=12)

            # Always-visible split: terminal/automation on left, map on right.
            self.main_pane = ttk.Panedwindow(self.root, orient="horizontal")
            self.main_pane.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=6, pady=(2, 3))
            left = ttk.Frame(self.main_pane)
            right = ttk.Frame(self.main_pane)
            self.main_pane.add(left, weight=4)
            self.main_pane.add(right, weight=2)

            self.notebook = ttk.Notebook(left)
            # Pack the notebook only after the fixed bottom controls have been
            # reserved. This guarantees that the command box can never be hidden
            # below the progress bars.
            terminal_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            rooms_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            aliases_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            scripts_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            triggers_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            variables_tab = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
            self.notebook.add(terminal_tab, text="🖥 Terminal")
            self.notebook.add(rooms_tab, text="🔎 Rooms")
            self.notebook.add(aliases_tab, text="⚡ Aliases")
            self.notebook.add(scripts_tab, text="📜 Scripts")
            self.notebook.add(triggers_tab, text="🎯 Triggers")
            self.notebook.add(variables_tab, text="Variables")

            terminal_frame = ttk.Frame(terminal_tab)
            terminal_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
            self.terminal = tk.Text(
                terminal_frame,
                bg="#000000",
                fg="#dddddd",
                insertbackground="#ffffff",
                wrap="word",
                undo=False,
                font=("TkFixedFont", 10),
            )
            terminal_scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(terminal_frame, orient="vertical", command=self.terminal.yview)
            self.terminal.configure(yscrollcommand=terminal_scroll.set)
            self.terminal.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
            terminal_scroll.pack(side="right", fill="y")
            self.renderer = AnsiTextRenderer(self.terminal)
            self._append_system(f"Loaded {len(self.client.mapper.rooms)} ARDABEST rooms. Pure-Python aliases, triggers, variables and scripts are ready.")
            self._append_system("Connecting automatically to rotsmud.org:3791. The map will center when RotS prints a room header.")

            # Rooms tab with in-client search/navigation.
            room_search = ttk.Frame(rooms_tab, padding=5)
            room_search.pack(fill="x")
            self.room_search_var = tk.StringVar()
            room_entry = ttk.Entry(room_search, textvariable=self.room_search_var)
            room_entry.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
            room_entry.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: self._populate_rooms(self.room_search_var.get()))
            ttk.Button(room_search, text="Find", command=lambda: self._populate_rooms(self.room_search_var.get())).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Button(room_search, text="Show selected", command=self._show_selected_room).pack(side="left")
            self.room_results = self._make_list(rooms_tab)
            self.room_results.bind("<Double-Button-1>", lambda _e: self._show_selected_room())
            self._room_result_objects: list[Room] = []

            self.alias_list = self._make_list(aliases_tab)
            script_bar = ttk.Frame(scripts_tab, padding=5)
            script_bar.pack(fill="x")
            ttk.Button(script_bar, text="Open scripts folder", command=lambda: open_folder(self.client.scripts.scripts_dir)).pack(side="left")
            ttk.Button(script_bar, text="Syntax-check and reload", command=self._reload_python).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Label(script_bar, text="A failed syntax check leaves the working modules loaded.").pack(side="left", padx=10)
            self.script_list = self._make_list(scripts_tab)
            self.trigger_list = self._make_list(triggers_tab)
            self.variable_list = self._make_list(variables_tab)

            # Permanently reserve the lower controls before allowing the notebook
            # to expand. The command line sits ABOVE the status bars so it remains
            # visible even on shorter desktop displays.
            bottom_controls = ttk.Frame(left)
            bottom_controls.pack(side="bottom", fill="x")

            command_outer = ttk.LabelFrame(bottom_controls, text="Type a MUD command and press Enter", padding=(5, 4))
            command_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=2, pady=(3, 2))
            self.command_var = tk.StringVar()
            self.command_entry = ttk.Entry(
                command_outer,
                textvariable=self.command_var,
                font=("TkFixedFont", 11),
            )
            self.command_entry.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, ipady=4)
            self.command_entry.bind("<Return>", self._submit_command)
            self.command_entry.bind("<Up>", self._history_up)
            self.command_entry.bind("<Down>", self._history_down)
            ttk.Button(command_outer, text="Send", command=self._submit_command, width=9).pack(
                side="left", padx=(5, 0)
            )

            status_frame = ttk.Frame(bottom_controls, padding=(2, 2))
            status_frame.pack(fill="x")
            self.status_bars: dict[str, tuple[ttk.Progressbar, ttk.Label]] = {}
            styles = {
                "Health": "Health.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
                "Mana": "Mana.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
                "Movement": "Movement.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
                "XP": "XP.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
            }
            for name in ("Health", "Mana", "Movement", "XP"):
                frame = ttk.Frame(status_frame)
                frame.pack(fill="x", pady=1)
                label = ttk.Label(frame, text=f"{name}: waiting for data", width=25)
                label.pack(side="left")
                bar = ttk.Progressbar(frame, maximum=100, value=0, style=styles[name])
                bar.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
                self.status_bars[name] = (bar, label)

            # The notebook receives only the space left above the permanent command
            # and status area.
            self.notebook.pack(side="top", fill="both", expand=True)
            self.command_entry.focus_set()

            # Permanent map panel on the right.
            map_bar = ttk.Frame(right, padding=(2, 2))
            map_bar.pack(fill="x")
            ttk.Label(map_bar, text="🧭 MAP").pack(side="left")
            ttk.Button(map_bar, text="−", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom_map(1 / 1.15)).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 1))
            ttk.Button(map_bar, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom_map(1.15)).pack(side="left")
            ttk.Button(map_bar, text="Center", command=self._center_map).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Button(map_bar, text="Overview", command=lambda: self.map_canvas.focus_overview()).pack(side="left")

            self.names_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=bool(self.client.profile.data.get("showNames", False)))
            self.grid_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=bool(self.client.profile.data.get("showGrid", True)))
            self.mapping_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=self.client.mapper.mapping_enabled)
            ttk.Checkbutton(map_bar, text="Names", variable=self.names_var, command=self._map_options).pack(side="left", padx=4)
            ttk.Checkbutton(map_bar, text="Grid", variable=self.grid_var, command=self._map_options).pack(side="left")
            ttk.Checkbutton(map_bar, text="Map new", variable=self.mapping_var, command=self._toggle_mapping).pack(side="left", padx=4)

            mode_box = ttk.Combobox(map_bar, textvariable=self.map_mode, values=("small", "medium", "large"), state="readonly", width=8)
            mode_box.pack(side="right")
            ttk.Label(map_bar, text="Mode:").pack(side="right", padx=(4, 2))
            mode_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda _e: self._apply_map_mode())

            self.room_line_var = tk.StringVar(value="Waiting for RotS room information…")
            ttk.Label(right, textvariable=self.room_line_var, foreground="#00aa55", anchor="w").pack(fill="x", padx=3)
            self.map_canvas = MapCanvas(right, self.client.mapper, self._set_map_status)
            self.map_canvas.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
            self.map_canvas.show_names = self.names_var.get()
            self.map_canvas.show_grid = self.grid_var.get()
            self.map_canvas.room_shape = "circle"

            self.map_info = tk.Text(
                right,
                height=5,
                bg="#070707",
                fg="#dddddd",
                insertbackground="#ffffff",
                relief="flat",
                font=("Consolas", 9),
                wrap="none",
            )
            self.map_info.pack(fill="x", pady=(2, 0))
            self.map_info.configure(state="disabled")
            self._set_map_info(None, "Connected room has not been detected yet")

            self.footer_var = tk.StringVar(value=f"XML: {self.client.xml_log_path}")
            ttk.Label(self.root, textvariable=self.footer_var, relief="sunken", anchor="w").pack(fill="x")

        def _make_list(self, parent: tk.Misc) -> tk.Listbox:
            frame = ttk.Frame(parent)
            frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=5, pady=5)
            box = tk.Listbox(frame, bg="#111111", fg="#eeeeee", font=("Consolas", 9))
            scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, command=box.yview)
            box.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)
            box.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
            scroll.pack(side="right", fill="y")
            return box

        def _initial_map_view(self) -> None:
            if self.client.mapper.current_room_id is not None:
                self.map_canvas.focus_current()
                self._set_map_info(self.client.mapper.rooms.get(self.client.mapper.current_room_id), "Restored saved location")
            else:
                self.map_canvas.focus_overview()
            self._apply_map_mode(preserve_center=True)
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.main_pane.sashpos(0, int(self.root.winfo_width() * 0.73))

        def connect(self) -> None:
            try:
                port = int(self.port_var.get())
            except ValueError:
                messagebox.showerror("Invalid port", "Port must be a number.", parent=self.root)
                return
            host = self.host_var.get().strip() or DEFAULT_HOST
            self.client.profile.data.update({"host": host, "port": port})
            self.client.profile.save()
            self.runtime.submit(self.client.connect(host, port))

        def _reload_python(self) -> None:
            self.runtime.submit(self.client.scripts.reload())
            self._append_system("Syntax-checking every Python module before reload…")

        def _save_profile(self) -> None:
            self.client.profile.save()
            self.client.mapper.save()
            self.client.variables.save()
            self.footer_var.set("Profile, variables and map saved")

        def _clear_terminal(self) -> None:
            self.terminal.delete("1.0", "end")

        def _focus_command_entry(self, _event: tk.Event | None = None) -> str:
            """Move keyboard focus to the always-visible command entry (Ctrl+L)."""
            self.notebook.select(0)
            self.command_entry.focus_set()
            self.command_entry.icursor("end")
            return "break"

        def _submit_command(self, _event: tk.Event | None = None) -> str:
            command = self.command_var.get()
            self.command_var.set("")
            if command:
                self.history.append(command)
                self.history_index = len(self.history)
                self.runtime.submit(self.client.send(command))
            return "break"

        def _history_up(self, _event: tk.Event) -> str:
            if self.history:
                self.history_index = max(0, self.history_index - 1)
                self.command_var.set(self.history[self.history_index])
                self.command_entry.icursor("end")
            return "break"

        def _history_down(self, _event: tk.Event) -> str:
            if self.history:
                self.history_index = min(len(self.history), self.history_index + 1)
                self.command_var.set("" if self.history_index == len(self.history) else self.history[self.history_index])
                self.command_entry.icursor("end")
            return "break"

        def _toggle_mapping(self) -> None:
            self.client.mapper.mapping_enabled = self.mapping_var.get()
            self.client.mapper.save()
            self._append_system(f"Dynamic mapping {'ON' if self.mapping_var.get() else 'OFF'}")

        def _map_options(self) -> None:
            self.map_canvas.show_names = self.names_var.get()
            self.map_canvas.show_grid = self.grid_var.get()
            self.client.profile.data.update({"showNames": self.names_var.get(), "showGrid": self.grid_var.get()})
            self.client.profile.save()
            self.map_canvas.redraw()

        def _apply_map_mode(self, preserve_center: bool = False) -> None:
            mode = self.map_mode.get().lower()
            self.client.profile.data["guiMapMode"] = mode
            self.client.profile.save()
            self.map_canvas.detail_mode = mode
            if mode == "small":
                self.map_canvas.zoom = 0.38
                self.map_canvas.show_names = False
            elif mode == "large":
                self.map_canvas.zoom = 1.20
                self.map_canvas.show_names = True
            else:
                self.map_canvas.zoom = 0.72
                self.map_canvas.show_names = self.names_var.get()
            self.map_canvas.redraw()
            self.footer_var.set(
                f"Map mode: {mode}. E = exits. Small maximizes rooms; medium shows exit letters; "
                "large shows room name, terrain, and exits."
            )

        def _zoom_map(self, factor: float) -> None:
            self.map_canvas.zoom = max(0.16, min(4.0, self.map_canvas.zoom * factor))
            self.map_canvas.redraw()

        def _center_map(self) -> None:
            if self.client.mapper.current_room_id is not None:
                self.map_canvas.focus_current()
            else:
                self.map_canvas.focus_overview()

        def _populate_rooms(self, query: str) -> None:
            query = query.strip()
            if query:
                rooms = self.client.mapper.search(query, 500)
            else:
                rooms = [room for room in self.client.mapper.rooms.values() if not room.deleted][:500]
            self._room_result_objects = rooms
            self.room_results.delete(0, "end")
            for room in rooms:
                area = self.client.mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area))
                exits = " ".join((room.observed_exits or list(room.exits.keys()))) or "-"
                self.room_results.insert("end", f"#{room.vnum or room.id:<7} {room.display_name()[:45]:45} [{room.terrain}] E:{exits} — {area}")

        def _show_selected_room(self) -> None:
            selection = self.room_results.curselection()
            if not selection:
                return
            room = self._room_result_objects[selection[0]]
            self.client.mapper.set_current(room.id)
            self.map_canvas.focus_current()
            self._set_map_info(room, "Location selected manually")

        def _set_map_info(self, room: Room | None, last: str = "") -> None:
            if room is None:
                lines = [
                    "ROOM  No current room",
                    "AREA  —",
                    "EXITS —",
                    "NOTE  Enter the game; the map will center when a room header arrives.",
                    f"LAST  {last or 'Waiting'}",
                ]
            else:
                area = self.client.mapper.areas.get(room.area, str(room.area))
                exits = " ".join(direction.upper() for direction in (room.observed_exits or list(room.exits.keys()))) or "—"
                lines = [
                    f"ROOM  {room.display_name()} (#{room.vnum or room.id}) [{room.terrain}]",
                    f"AREA  {area}   coordinates=({room.x}, {room.y}, {room.z})",
                    f"EXITS {exits}",
                    f"NOTE  {room.note or '—'}",
                    f"LAST  {last or 'Map updated dynamically from the room graph'}",
                ]
            self.map_info.configure(state="normal")
            self.map_info.delete("1.0", "end")
            self.map_info.insert("1.0", "\n".join(lines))
            self.map_info.configure(state="disabled")

        def _set_map_status(self, text: str) -> None:
            self.footer_var.set(text)

        def _append_system(self, text: str) -> None:
            self.terminal.tag_configure("system", foreground="#55ddaa")
            self.terminal.insert("end", f"\n[ArdaBest] {text}\n", "system")
            self.terminal.see("end")

        def _poll_events(self) -> None:
            try:
                for _ in range(500):
                    topic, payload = self.ui_queue.get_nowait()
                    self._handle_event(topic, payload)
            except queue.Empty:
                pass
            if self.root.winfo_exists():
                self.root.after(40, self._poll_events)

        def _handle_event(self, topic: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
            if topic == "network.text":
                self.renderer.append(str(payload.get("text", "")))
            elif topic == "system.message":
                self._append_system(str(payload.get("text", "")))
            elif topic == "connection.connecting":
                self.connection_label.configure(text=f"Connecting {payload.get('host')}:{payload.get('port')}…", style="Disconnected.TLabel")
            elif topic == "connection.connected":
                self.connection_label.configure(text=f"Connected {payload.get('host')}:{payload.get('port')}", style="Connected.TLabel")
                self._append_system(f"Connected to {payload.get('host')}:{payload.get('port')}")
            elif topic == "connection.disconnected":
                self.connection_label.configure(text="Disconnected", style="Disconnected.TLabel")
                self._append_system(f"Disconnected: {payload.get('reason', '')}")
            elif topic == "connection.error":
                self.connection_label.configure(text="Connection error", style="Disconnected.TLabel")
                self._append_system(f"Connection error: {payload.get('error')}")
            elif topic == "mapper.room":
                room = self.client.mapper.rooms.get(self.client.mapper.current_room_id) if self.client.mapper.current_room_id is not None else None
                self.room_line_var.set(str(payload.get("summary", room.display_name() if room else "Current room")))
                self.map_canvas.focus_current()
                self._set_map_info(room, "RotS room header received; NetworkX graph view updated")
            elif topic == "mapper.mode":
                self.mapping_var.set(bool(payload.get("enabled")))
            elif topic == "status.update":
                self._set_bar("Health", payload.get("hp"), payload.get("hp_max"))
                self._set_bar("Mana", payload.get("mana"), payload.get("mana_max"))
                self._set_bar("Movement", payload.get("movement"), payload.get("movement_max"))
            elif topic == "xp.update":
                need = payload.get("need")
                total = payload.get("total")
                if isinstance(need, int) and isinstance(total, int) and total > 0:
                    self._set_bar("XP", total - need, total)
            elif topic == "script.error":
                self._refresh_automation()
                self._append_system(f"Script reload rejected; old working modules remain active.\n{payload.get('path')}\n{payload.get('error')}")
            elif topic == "script.loaded":
                self._refresh_automation()
                self._append_system(f"Loaded Python module: {payload.get('path', '')}")
            elif topic in {"alias.matched", "trigger.matched", "variable.changed", "client.ready"}:
                self._refresh_automation()
            elif topic == "client.quit-requested":
                self.close()

        def _set_bar(self, name: str, current: Any, maximum: Any) -> None:
            if not isinstance(current, int) or not isinstance(maximum, int) or maximum <= 0:
                return
            bar, label = self.status_bars[name]
            bar.configure(maximum=maximum, value=max(0, min(maximum, current)))
            label.configure(text=f"{name}: {current}/{maximum}")

        def _refresh_automation(self) -> None:
            self.alias_list.delete(0, "end")
            for rule in self.client.automation.aliases:
                self.alias_list.insert("end", f"{'ON ' if rule.enabled else 'OFF'} {rule.name}: {rule.pattern_text}")
            self.trigger_list.delete(0, "end")
            for rule in self.client.automation.triggers:
                self.trigger_list.insert("end", f"{'ON ' if rule.enabled else 'OFF'} {rule.name}: {rule.pattern_text}")
            self.variable_list.delete(0, "end")
            for key, value in sorted(self.client.variables.items()):
                self.variable_list.insert("end", f"{key} = {value!r}")
            self.script_list.delete(0, "end")
            for path in sorted(self.client.scripts.scripts_dir.glob("*.py")):
                self.script_list.insert("end", path.name)

        def close(self) -> None:
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self.client.profile.data["guiMapMode"] = self.map_mode.get()
                self.client.profile.save()
            self.root.withdraw()
            self.runtime.stop()
            self.root.destroy()


async def headless_session(client: MudClientCore, host: str, port: int) -> None:
    await client.startup()
    await client.connect(host, port)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    print(f"Connected to {host}:{port}. XML log: {client.xml_log_path}")
    print("Type /help for local commands. Ctrl-D exits.")

    def print_text(topic: str, text: str, **_: Any) -> None:
        if topic == "network.text":
            print(strip_ansi(text), end="", flush=True)
    client.bus.subscribe("network.text", print_text)

    while client.connection.connected:
        try:
            line = await loop.run_in_executor(None, sys.stdin.readline)
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            break
        if not line:
            break
        await client.send(line.rstrip("\r\n"))
    await client.shutdown()


async def terminal_map_session(client: MudClientCore, host: str, port: int, auto_connect: bool = True) -> None:
    ui = TerminalMapUI(client, host, port, auto_connect=auto_connect)
    await ui.run()


def build_argument_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"{APP_NAME}. With no arguments it opens the graphical terminal/map "
            f"and connects to {DEFAULT_HOST}:{DEFAULT_PORT}."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=DEFAULT_HOST, help=f"MUD host (default: {DEFAULT_HOST})")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=DEFAULT_PORT, help=f"MUD port (default: {DEFAULT_PORT})")
    parser.add_argument("--profile-dir", type=Path, default=profile_default_path())

    display = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    display.add_argument("--gui", action="store_true", help="Use the graphical terminal and map (default)")
    display.add_argument("--terminal-map", action="store_true", help="Use the alternate-screen terminal map")
    display.add_argument("--headless", action="store_true", help="Use simple line-oriented terminal mode")

    parser.add_argument("--map-mode", choices=("small", "medium", "large"), default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--connect", dest="connect", action="store_true", default=True, help="Connect immediately (default)")
    parser.add_argument("--no-connect", dest="connect", action="store_false", help="Open without connecting")
    parser.add_argument("--no-zmq", action="store_true", help="Do not start the ZeroMQ ROUTER socket")
    parser.add_argument("--zmq-endpoint", default=None, help="ROUTER bind endpoint, e.g. tcp://127.0.0.1:5555")
    return parser


def dependency_errors(terminal_map: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    if nx is None:
        errors.append("networkx")
    if zmq is None:
        errors.append("pyzmq")
    if terminal_map and Application is None:
        errors.append("prompt_toolkit")
    return errors


def main(argv: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_argument_parser().parse_args(argv)
    use_terminal_map = bool(args.terminal_map)
    missing = dependency_errors(use_terminal_map)
    if missing:
        print(
            "Missing required package(s): " + ", ".join(missing) + "\n"
            "Run install_ardabest_rots_complete_linux_no_root.py, or install them with:\n"
            f"  {sys.executable} -m pip install networkx pyzmq prompt_toolkit",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 2

    ui_events: queue.Queue[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]] = queue.Queue()
    wants_gui = not (args.headless or use_terminal_map)
    try:
        client = MudClientCore(args.profile_dir, ui_events if wants_gui else None)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Could not initialize client: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    client.profile.data.update({"host": args.host, "port": args.port})
    if args.map_mode:
        client.profile.data["guiMapMode"] = args.map_mode
        client.profile.data["terminalMapMode"] = args.map_mode
    if args.no_zmq:
        client.profile.data["zmqEnabled"] = False
    if args.zmq_endpoint:
        client.profile.data.update({"zmqEnabled": True, "zmqEndpoint": args.zmq_endpoint})
    client.profile.save()

    if use_terminal_map:
        try:
            asyncio.run(terminal_map_session(client, args.host, args.port, auto_connect=args.connect))
            return 0
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            return 130
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Terminal map failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

    if args.headless:
        try:
            asyncio.run(headless_session(client, args.host, args.port))
            return 0
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            return 130

    if tk is None:
        print("tkinter is unavailable. Install a Python build that includes Tk/Tcl, then run the no-root installer again.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    root = tk.Tk()
    runtime = AsyncRuntime(client)
    runtime.start()
    MudClientGUI(root, client, runtime, ui_events, args.host, args.port, auto_connect=args.connect)
    try:
        root.mainloop()
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            runtime.stop()
        return 130


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# END OF FILE: ardabest_rots_complete_linux_client.py

class InstallError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def default_install_dir() -> Path:
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME")
    base = Path(xdg).expanduser() if xdg else Path.home() / ".local" / "share"
    return base / "ardabest-rots-complete-client"


def default_bin_dir() -> Path:
    return Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"


def default_applications_dir() -> Path:
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME")
    base = Path(xdg).expanduser() if xdg else Path.home() / ".local" / "share"
    return base / "applications"


def quote(value: str | Path) -> str:
    import shlex
    return shlex.quote(str(value))


def run(command: list[str], *, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    print("> " + " ".join(quote(part) for part in command), flush=True)
    try:
        return subprocess.run(command, check=check, text=True)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise InstallError(f"Required program was not found: {command[0]}") from exc
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
        raise InstallError(f"Command failed with exit code {exc.returncode}: {command[0]}") from exc


def require_linux_non_root(*, dry_run: bool) -> None:
    if not sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
        raise InstallError("This installer is for Linux.")
    if sys.version_info < (3, 10):
        raise InstallError("Python 3.10 or newer is required.")
    if hasattr(os, "geteuid") and os.geteuid() == 0 and not dry_run:
        raise InstallError(
            "Do not run this installer with sudo or as root. Run it as your normal user:\n"
            "  python3 install_ardabest_rots_complete_linux_no_root.py"
        )


def verify_tkinter() -> None:
    try:
        import tkinter  # noqa: F401
    except Exception as exc:
        raise InstallError(
            "The graphical client needs a Python installation that includes Tk/Tcl. "
            "This no-root installer will not install system packages. Use a user-accessible "
            f"Python build with Tk and run the installer again. Python reported: {exc}"
        ) from exc


def decode_client() -> bytes:
    try:
        compact = "".join(PAYLOAD_B85.split())
        data = zlib.decompress(base64.b85decode(compact.encode("ascii")))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise InstallError(f"The embedded client payload is damaged: {exc}") from exc
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != CLIENT_SHA256:
        raise InstallError("The embedded client failed its SHA-256 integrity check.")
    return data


def write_atomic(path: Path, data: bytes, mode: int | None = None) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(data)
        tmp.flush()
        os.fsync(tmp.fileno())
        temporary = Path(tmp.name)
    temporary.replace(path)
    if mode is not None:
        path.chmod(mode)


def ensure_pip(python_exe: Path) -> None:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [str(python_exe), "-m", "pip", "--version"],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        check=False,
    )
    if result.returncode == 0:
        return
    result = subprocess.run([str(python_exe), "-m", "ensurepip", "--user", "--upgrade"], check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise InstallError(
            "This Python installation has neither venv nor pip. The installer cannot alter "
            "system packages without root. Use a user-accessible Python with venv or pip."
        )


def make_python_environment(install_dir: Path, *, skip_dependencies: bool, dry_run: bool) -> tuple[Path, Path | None]:
    venv_dir = install_dir / ".venv"
    venv_python = venv_dir / "bin" / "python"
    if dry_run:
        print(f"Would create private environment: {venv_dir}")
        if not skip_dependencies:
            print("Would install privately: " + ", ".join(DEPENDENCIES))
        return venv_python, None

    if not venv_python.exists():
        print("Creating a private Python environment (no root)...", flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "venv", str(venv_dir)], check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0 or not venv_python.exists():
            print("venv is unavailable; using a private package directory instead.", flush=True)
            shutil.rmtree(venv_dir, ignore_errors=True)
            target = install_dir / "python-packages"
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            base_python = Path(sys.executable)
            ensure_pip(base_python)
            if not skip_dependencies:
                run([
                    str(base_python), "-m", "pip", "install",
                    "--disable-pip-version-check", "--no-input", "--upgrade",
                    "--target", str(target), *DEPENDENCIES,
                ])
            return base_python, target

    if not skip_dependencies:
        print("Installing NetworkX, PyZMQ, and Prompt Toolkit privately...", flush=True)
        run([
            str(venv_python), "-m", "pip", "install",
            "--disable-pip-version-check", "--no-input", "--upgrade",
            *DEPENDENCIES,
        ])
    return venv_python, None


def launcher_body(python_exe: Path, client_path: Path, pythonpath: Path | None, mode_args: str) -> bytes:
    env_line = ""
    if pythonpath is not None:
        env_line = f"export PYTHONPATH={quote(pythonpath)}${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}\n"
    return (
        "#!/bin/sh\n"
        "set -eu\n"
        + env_line
        + f"exec {quote(python_exe)} {quote(client_path)} {mode_args} --connect --host rotsmud.org --port 3791 \"$@\"\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def create_launchers(
    bin_dir: Path,
    python_exe: Path,
    client_path: Path,
    pythonpath: Path | None,
    *,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    gui = bin_dir / "ardabest-rots"
    terminal = bin_dir / "ardabest-rots-terminal-map"
    if dry_run:
        print(f"Would create GUI launcher: {gui}")
        print(f"Would create terminal-map launcher: {terminal}")
    else:
        write_atomic(gui, launcher_body(python_exe, client_path, pythonpath, "--gui"), 0o755)
        write_atomic(terminal, launcher_body(python_exe, client_path, pythonpath, "--terminal-map"), 0o755)
    return gui, terminal


def create_desktop_entries(app_dir: Path, gui: Path, terminal: Path, *, dry_run: bool) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    gui_entry = app_dir / "ardabest-rots.desktop"
    terminal_entry = app_dir / "ardabest-rots-terminal-map.desktop"
    gui_text = textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        [Desktop Entry]
        Type=Application
        Version=1.0
        Name=ArdaBest RotS MUD Client
        Comment=Pure-Python RotS client with a live NetworkX map
        Exec={gui}
        Icon=utilities-terminal
        Terminal=false
        Categories=Game;Network;
        StartupNotify=true
    """)
    terminal_text = textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        [Desktop Entry]
        Type=Application
        Version=1.0
        Name=ArdaBest RotS Terminal Map
        Comment=Alternate-screen 80x24 terminal mapper
        Exec={terminal}
        Icon=utilities-terminal
        Terminal=true
        Categories=Game;Network;
        StartupNotify=true
    """)
    if dry_run:
        print(f"Would create menu entries: {gui_entry}, {terminal_entry}")
    else:
        write_atomic(gui_entry, gui_text.encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
        write_atomic(terminal_entry, terminal_text.encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
        update = shutil.which("update-desktop-database")
        if update:
            subprocess.run([update, str(app_dir)], check=False, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return gui_entry, terminal_entry


def create_uninstaller(
    path: Path,
    install_dir: Path,
    launchers: tuple[Path, Path],
    desktop_entries: tuple[Path, Path],
    *,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> None:
    removals = "".join(f"rm -f {quote(p)}\n" for p in (*launchers, *desktop_entries))
    body = (
        "#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\n"
        + removals
        + f"rm -rf {quote(install_dir)}\n"
        + "printf '%s\n' 'ArdaBest application files removed.'\n"
        + "printf '%s\n' 'The profile remains in ~/.local/share/ardabest-python-profile.'\n"
    )
    if dry_run:
        print(f"Would create uninstaller: {path}")
    else:
        write_atomic(path, body.encode("utf-8"), 0o755)


def launch(gui_launcher: Path, *, no_launch: bool, dry_run: bool) -> None:
    if no_launch:
        return
    if not (os.environ.get("DISPLAY") or os.environ.get("WAYLAND_DISPLAY")):
        print("No graphical desktop session detected. Installation is complete; run ardabest-rots later.")
        return
    if dry_run:
        print(f"Would launch: {gui_launcher}")
        return
    subprocess.Popen(
        [str(gui_launcher)],
        cwd=str(gui_launcher.parent),
        start_new_session=True,
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Install the complete ArdaBest RotS client without root.")
    p.add_argument("--install-dir", type=Path, default=default_install_dir())
    p.add_argument("--no-launch", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--skip-dependencies", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--no-shortcuts", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args()
    try:
        require_linux_non_root(dry_run=args.dry_run)
        verify_tkinter()
        install_dir = args.install_dir.expanduser().resolve()
        client_path = install_dir / CLIENT_NAME
        print("=" * 74)
        print(APP_NAME + " — Linux no-root installer")
        print("No sudo, root, system package manager, or Y/N questions will be used.")
        print(f"Install directory: {install_dir}")
        print("=" * 74)

        if args.dry_run:
            print(f"Would write embedded client: {client_path}")
        else:
            install_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            write_atomic(client_path, decode_client(), 0o755)

        python_exe, pythonpath = make_python_environment(
            install_dir,
            skip_dependencies=args.skip_dependencies,
            dry_run=args.dry_run,
        )

        if args.no_shortcuts:
            local_bin = install_dir
            app_dir = install_dir
        else:
            local_bin = default_bin_dir()
            app_dir = default_applications_dir()

        launchers = create_launchers(local_bin, python_exe, client_path, pythonpath, dry_run=args.dry_run)
        if args.no_shortcuts:
            desktop_entries = (install_dir / "unused-gui.desktop", install_dir / "unused-terminal.desktop")
        else:
            desktop_entries = create_desktop_entries(app_dir, *launchers, dry_run=args.dry_run)
        create_uninstaller(
            install_dir / "uninstall.sh",
            install_dir,
            launchers,
            desktop_entries,
            dry_run=args.dry_run,
        )

        print("\nINSTALLATION COMPLETE")
        print(f"GUI launcher:          {launchers[0]}")
        print(f"Terminal-map launcher: {launchers[1]}")
        print("Server:                rotsmud.org:3791")
        print("ZMQ ROUTER:            tcp://127.0.0.1:5555")
        print("Profile:               ~/.local/share/ardabest-python-profile")
        print("XML logs:              profile/logs/*.xml")
        print("No files were installed as root.")
        launch(launchers[0], no_launch=args.no_launch, dry_run=args.dry_run)
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nInstallation cancelled.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 130
    except InstallError as exc:
        print("\nINSTALLATION FAILED", file=sys.stderr)
        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"\nUnexpected installer error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
